papers.title: ACSeL: Adaptive Configuration Search for Hardware-Constrained LLM Inference
papers.summary: Serving large language models (LLMs) under tight memory and latency service-level objectives (SLOs), including on edge devices, requires jointly selecting the model size, batch size, quantization algorithm, and mixed-precision quantization recipes. Exhaustive search over this combinatorially large space is infeasible. Unlike data-center serving, which often prioritizes throughput or generation speed, resource-constrained deployments typically set memory and latency budgets as constraints and then seek the configuration with the highest generation quality among feasible ones. To this end, we propose ACSeL, a framework that identifies configurations predicted to satisfy deployment constraints while achieving high predicted generation quality. To enable efficient quality estimation, we use Relative Model Quality Degradation (RMQD), a proxy based on the divergence between the candidate and reference models' next-token distributions over a small calibration corpus. Across the evaluated model sizes and precisions, RMQD is inexpensive to evaluate and strongly correlated with downstream benchmark performance. ACSeL combines (i) a lightweight quality surrogate that predicts RMQD directly from a configuration; (ii) Few-shot Median Calibration (FMC), which calibrates operator-profile-based latency estimates using a small number of end-to-end profiles; and (iii) a structured search algorithm BandPareto for exploring layerwise mixed-precision configurations. Experiments on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 workstation and an NVIDIA Jetson Thor edge platform show that FMC substantially improves deployment feasibility, while BandPareto + FMC achieves the highest feasibility and the lowest RMQD gaps to the best measured configurations in the evaluation set.
papers.title_ja: ACSeL: ハードウェア制約下におけるLLM推論のための適応的構成探索
papers.summary_ja: メモリとレイテンシの厳密な制約下でLLMを効率的にサービングするための構成探索フレームワークを提案する。モデルサイズ、バッチサイズ、量子化アルゴリズム、混合精度レシピの組み合わせ空間を効率的に探索し、制約を満たしつつ生成品質を最大化する構成を特定する。軽量なサロゲートモデルとFew-shot Median Calibration (FMC) により、オペレータプロファイルベースのレイテンシ推定を校正し、BandPareto アルゴリズムで層ごとの混合精度構成を探索する。NVIDIA RTX A6000 および Jetson Thor での実験により、FMC がデプロイ可能性を大幅に向上させ、BandPareto + FMC が最高効率と最低の品質劣化ギャップを実現することを示した。

papers.title: WaSP: Wasserstein Data Synthesis Pipeline for Solver-Free Operator Learning
papers.summary: Neural operators offer fast surrogates for solving PDEs, but training them typically requires expensive input-solution pairs. Two solver-free alternatives include physics-informed learning and training on manufactured data. Physics-informed learning approximates solutions by minimizing PDE residuals. While the residual norm must be strong enough to control solution error, stronger norms increase mini-batch variance and hinder optimization. Manufactured data constructs input-solution pairs for learning by applying the PDE operator to artificial solutions. However, the resulting training distribution can be mutually singular with the target distribution, yielding poor accuracy on the target distribution. We introduce the Wasserstein Data Synthesis Pipeline (WaSP), which trains on manufactured input-solution pairs while gradually mitigating the distribution shift. WaSP synthesizes new pairs by applying the learned operator to a path of intermediate distributions converging to the target input distribution. Training proceeds in stages along this path. At each stage, the previous surrogate generates solutions, and the exact PDE operator derives corresponding inputs, yielding training pairs for the next surrogate. Theoretically, we prove a stepwise error-propagation bound for the distribution shift introduced during synthesis. Empirically, WaSP reduces solution error by $3.9\times$ to $9.5\times$ compared to existing solver-free methods on PDEs such as Allen-Cahn, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky, and Ginzburg-Landau, and better reproduces the two chaotic systems' statistical observables.
papers.title_ja: WaSP: ソルバー不要なオペレータ学習のためのワッサーシュタインデータ合成パイプライン
papers.summary_ja: ニューラルオペレータの学習において、高コストな入力・解ペアの生成を回避する手法として、WaSP（Wasserstein Data Synthesis Pipeline）を提案する。本手法は、製造データを用いた学習時の分布シフトを段階的に緩和し、ターゲット分布に収束させることで精度を向上させる。理論的には分布シフトによる誤差伝播の境界を証明し、Allen-CahnやKuramoto-SivashinskyなどのPDEにおいて、既存のソルバー不要手法と比較して解の誤差を3.9〜9.5倍低減することを示した。

papers.title: Simple Meta-Learning for HPO and CASH Using Performance Representations
papers.summary: Bayesian optimization for Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) and Combined Algorithm Selection and Hyperparameter Optimization (CASH) often relies on explicit hyperparameter encodings as surrogate inputs. In high-dimensional search spaces, however, such representations can make it difficult for standard surrogates to learn useful performance models. We instead study an alternative meta-learning representation that describes each configuration directly as its historical performance across prior tasks. This representation can be paired directly with standard surrogate models. Our scope is the iterative selection component of AutoML, deciding which configuration to evaluate next from a fixed candidate set, rather than a complete framework with features such as runtime estimation, cost-aware budgeting and ensembling. We further apply this representation to maximal marginal relevance (MMR), a diversity-based re-ranking criterion from recommender systems, as a posterior-free acquisition rule. When selecting and optimising across multiple models on the TabArena benchmark, the performance-based representation paired with a linear Bayesian ridge regression model outperforms dedicated meta-learning baselines, achieving the same tuned performance in roughly half the number of trials. For single-model HPO, it remains a competitive second. Across both benchmarks this method closely matches or improves on regret at a fraction of the complexity and cost, requiring no pre-training or tuning and scaling independently of search space dimensionality. Code for reproducing our results is available at https://github.com/EWitting/simple-metalearning.
papers.title_ja: 性能表現を用いたHPOおよびCASHのための単純なメタ学習
papers.summary_ja: ハイパーパラメータ最適化（HPO）において、高次元空間でのサロゲートモデルの学習困難さを解決するため、設定を過去のタスクでの性能履歴として表現するメタ学習手法を提案する。この表現は標準的なサロゲートモデルと組み合わせ可能であり、推薦システム由来の多様性基準MMRを後確率不要な獲得関数として適用する。TabArenaベンチマークにおいて、線形ベイズリッジ回帰と組み合わせることで、専用のメタ学習ベースラインを上回り、約半分の試行回数で同等の性能を達成した。事前学習やチューニングを必要とせず、探索空間の次元数に依存せずにスケーリングできる点が特徴である。

papers.title: A hierarchy of physics-embedded neural operators for structural dynamic surrogate modelingA hierarchy of physics-embedded neural operators for structural dynamic surrogate modeling
papers.summary: Structural-response surrogates must capture moving resonances, phase changes, and unequal-amplitude transfer channels during optimization or health-state changes. Physics-embedded learning seeks FEA-level accuracy at lower cost by embedding physics in inputs, forward passes, losses, and backpropagation. We propose Modal Rational (MR), mapping structural features to modal quantities for analytical frequency-response reconstruction. The Physics-Guided Modal Operator Network (PGMON) adds bounded frequency, damping, and residual-flexibility corrections. Modal Operator with Structural GELU and Anchored-SIREN Correction (MOSAIC) denotes the bounded spectral-discrepancy framework used here; MOSAIC-MR and MOSAIC-PGMON add such discrepancies. They support finite-dimensional maps and physical decoders for future neural operators; evidence is fixed-topology, not a completed operator comparison. Two 20,000-design populations are studied: an 80 m steel truss tower with variable member areas and attached masses, and a tapered shell beam with ten variable station masses. Archived tests cover ten designs and seven acceleration histories per structure; they are benchmarks, not seismic-design assessments. With 5% reference modal damping, MR, PGMON, and MOSAIC give mean displacement-history errors of 0.73-0.76% for the tower and 0.029-0.116% for the beam, against declared band-limited modal references. Supplied modal frequencies are distinguished from design-only use; unequal parameter counts and training settings are explicit. Error analysis separates learned modal discrepancies, truncation, and excitation weighting, explaining acceleration and difficult-tower limits and risks of blind use. Results support physically structured prediction but limit claims about generalization, computational savings, and added corrections. Next is developing and validating neural operators around these architectures.
papers.title_ja: 構造動的サロゲートモデリングのための物理埋め込み型ニューラルオペレータ階層
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、構造力学のサロゲートモデリングにおいて、物理法則を学習プロセスに埋め込むことで精度と効率を両立させる手法を提案する。モーダル特性を解析的に再構成するMR、物理ガイド型補正を行うPGMON、およびスペクトル誤差を枠組みとするMOSAICという階層的アーキテクチャを設計した。80mの鋼鉄トラス塔とテーパーシェルビームを対象とした検証では、参照解に対する平均変位履歴誤差が0.03〜0.76%と極めて低いことを示した。ただし、これは固定トポロジーでの検証であり、汎用的なニューラルオペレータとしての比較や計算コスト削減の定量的評価は今後の課題として残されている。

papers.title: Efficient Projection-Based Reduced-Order Modeling for Computational Fluid Dynamics via Multifidelity Basis Construction
papers.summary: Projection-based reduced-order models (PROMs) accelerate computational fluid dynamics simulations, but generating high-fidelity (HF) training snapshots remains expensive. We present a multifidelity methodology that reduces offline basis-construction costs by combining a small HF database with low-fidelity (LF) solutions. The method accommodates discrepancies in physical models and spatial discretizations. Parameter-matched HF and aligned LF snapshots define a correction basis. At new parameters, LF predictions are corrected by minimizing the HF residual over an affine trial space, with selective Reynolds-averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) smoothing. Accepted snapshots enrich the training database and update the correction basis. The resulting basis is compatible with conventional projection methods, including least-squares Petrov-Galerkin projection. For steady flow over a NACA0012 airfoil, using fine-grid RANS and coarse-grid Euler models, four HF snapshots and 36 LF-derived snapshots reduce snapshot-generation cost by a factor of 7.8. At basis dimension 40, mean lift, drag, and lift-to-drag ratio errors are 1.1%, 3.6%, and 3.9%, and the mean relative skin-friction error is approximately 5%, compared with 0.18%, 2.9%, 2.8%, and 4% for an HF-only PROM. Errors are evaluated against fully converged HF solutions on a test set emphasizing shock-containing flows. Increasing the initial HF snapshot count raises cost without monotonically improving accuracy. Among the tested multifidelity configurations, ten initial HF snapshots give the lowest aerodynamic errors at dimension 40; increasing the count to twelve worsens all three. The results demonstrate reduced snapshot-generation costs while retaining compatibility with established PROM formulations.
papers.title_ja: 多忠実度基底構築による計算流体力学のための効率的な射影ベース縮約モデル
papers.summary_ja: 計算流体力学（CFD）における高忠実度（HF）スナップショット生成のコスト削減を目的とした、多忠実度縮約モデル（PROM）手法を提案する。低忠実度（LF）解とHF解の残差を最小化する補正基底を構築し、従来の射影法と互換性を保ちながら計算効率を向上させる。NACA0012翼型を用いた検証では、HFスナップショットを4点に抑えることで生成コストを約7.8倍削減しつつ、揚力・抗力などの誤差を許容範囲内に抑えた。HFスナップショット数の増加が必ずしも精度向上に繋がらないことを示し、最適な初期HF点数の存在を実証した。

papers.title: Octopus: One Brain, Many Branches for Latent-KV Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Multi-agent LLM systems explore in parallel by spawning sub-agents with isolated context windows, whereas single-agent systems append every search and verification step into one growing trajectory. However, existing multi-agent frameworks duplicate prefix KV caches across branches, exchange findings by re-prefilling text summaries, and flatten or drop cross-branch dependencies during reinforcement learning (RL). We introduce Octopus, a single-model multi-agent RL framework in which all threads share one backbone and coordinate over a GPU-resident directed acyclic graph (DAG) of KV states through five primitives (fork, read_thread, wait_threads, rewind, commit). Octopus combines three co-designed mechanisms: (1) Zero-Copy Radix Forking, which spawns branches as $\mathcal{O}(1)$ cursor views over shared physical KV pages; (2) Attention-Only KV Mounting, which mounts a sibling thread's terminal KV blocks directly into full-attention layers while bypassing linear-recurrent states (Gated DeltaNet / Mamba-2), cutting off-task hijacking by $21\times$ ($57.9\% \to 2.7\%$) while retaining $92.2\%$ of full-text mutual information at zero extra KV allocation; and (3) a Packed DAG-GRPO Trainer, which packs all episode branches into one block-sparse attention pass and assigns counterfactual branch credit via leave-one-branch-out marginal rewards. Trained end-to-end with GRPO on Qwen3.5-4B over a sparse BM25 corpus, Octopus reaches $49.6\%$ accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus ($+17.5$ points over single-agent GRPO at 143K context and $+12.5$ points over text-summary multi-agent RL) and $51.2\%$ on OpenResearcher, outperforming dense-retrieval agents up to $250\times$ larger while increasing training throughput $3.3\times$ and cutting peak KV memory $2.8\times$.

papers.title: Resource-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Post-Training through Elastic Expert Parallelism
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning post-training improves the capabilities of large language models, but generating training responses is a major computational bottleneck. In mixture-of-experts models, workers that finish their assigned responses may remain occupied because their experts are still needed by workers processing longer responses. Consequently, approximately one-third of occupied worker time in the baseline occurs after local response generation finishes. Here we present FlexFloor, a system that enables earlier resource release during synchronous response generation while preserving the expert computation required by ongoing responses. FlexFloor jointly adapts response scheduling and the active group of workers. It uses historical response lengths and memory constraints to guide batching and prompt placement, then progressively releases workers while maintaining expert availability and correct communication. Compared with the verl baseline, FlexFloor generates approximately 65.40% more response tokens per unit of occupied computing time and increases response generation throughput by 52.74%, with little observed variation in rollout reward. By making reinforcement learning post-training more efficient, FlexFloor supports faster development and iterative improvement of large language models and AI agents.
papers.title_ja: 弾性エキスパート並列処理によるリソース効率の良い強化学習ポストトレーニング

papers.title: LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
papers.summary: Autoregressive decoding relies on the KV cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length and caps batch size and throughput. Existing post-training methods exploit redundancy across tokens, layers, and feature dimensions, or lower numerical precision. We identify a complementary axis: within each attention head, values are largely predictable from their corresponding keys. We exploit this with value cache amortisation, which fits a lightweight per-head predictor at test time and stores residuals only for the tokens it reconstructs worst, giving $4\times$ near-lossless value compression. The predictor can be initialised by meta-learning for substantially reduced prefill overhead, or fitted from scratch in settings that allow a one-off cost, such as multi-query inference. We pair value amortisation with cross-layer low-rank key compression to produce LowRAM, an asymmetric compression pipeline that stays close to lossless across three model families. By reconstructing only a selected subset of KV pairs at each decoding step, LowRAM can keep decoding overhead minimal and achieve up to $5\times$ higher peak decode throughput at $4\times$ compression. LowRAM further composes with quantisation and eviction, reaching $26.9\times$ compression at $94.5\%$ of baseline performance on long contexts. These results show that treating keys and values as structurally distinct enables efficient, aggressive, and composable KV cache compression.
papers.title_ja: LowRAM: テスト時における合成可能なKVキャッシュ圧縮のための低ランクキーと償却値
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMの推論時メモリボトルネックであるKVキャッシュの圧縮手法「LowRAM」を提案する。アテンションヘッド内で値（Value）がキー（Key）から予測可能である性質を利用し、軽量な予測器で値を再構成し残差のみ保存することで、約4倍のほぼ無損失な値圧縮を実現する。さらに層間低ランクキー圧縮と組み合わせることで、ピークデコードスループットを最大5倍向上させ、量子化やエビクションとの合成により最大26.9倍の圧縮率を達成する。

papers.title: TileQuant: Tile as the Precision-Allocation Unit for LLM Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization
papers.summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces large language model (LLM) deployment costs, but preserving quality requires accounting for uneven weight sensitivity. Uniform PTQ uses one weight bit-width, importance-aware PTQ adjusts scales or reconstructs weights within that width, and column-wise mixed precision retains selected columns at higher precision. However, sensitivity varies within columns, so whole-column retention also protects less sensitive weights, while runtime outlier detection adds decoding overhead. We therefore introduce TileQuant, a training-free framework that assigns precision to hardware-aligned 2D weight tiles. Offline calibration provides input-activation-aware scoring from forward statistics for lower calibration cost and gradient-informed scoring from loss sensitivity for stronger quality preservation. Within each projection's retention budget, the highest-scoring tiles remain at 16-bit and the rest use 8-bit. The resulting map guides reconstruction into compact weight buffers, which the kernel reuses for native integer and 16-bit computation with local accumulation to reduce memory traffic. Experiments show that TileQuant reaches 2.66x the original model's generation throughput. Across language modeling, reasoning, long-context retrieval, and question answering, it preserves quality and surpasses quantized and original models on multiple tasks. These results support selecting precision units that capture local sensitivity while enabling efficient hardware execution. The implementation is: https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/TileQuant
papers.title_ja: TileQuant: LLM混合精度後学習量子化における精度配分単位としてのタイル
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）の推論コスト削減を目的とした、訓練不要な混合精度量子化フレームワーク「TileQuant」を提案する。重みの感度が列内で不均一である問題に対し、ハードウェアに整合した2次元タイル単位で精度を割り当てることで、重要度の高い部分のみを16ビット、その他を8ビットとして効率化する。オフラインキャリブレーションによる活性化認識スコアリングと損失感度に基づくスコアリングを用い、メモリトラフィックを低減するカーネル実装を実現した。実験では、元のモデル比で2.66倍の生成スループットを達成しつつ、言語モデリングや推論タスクにおいて品質を維持または向上させることを示した。

papers.title: Recursive Sparse Attention: Million-Token Length Extrapolation at Logarithmic Cost
papers.summary: At context lengths of about 1M tokens, dense attention is costly in prefill and decoding, and training typically relies on long documents, which become scarcer as the target length increases. Most sparse attention methods score all preceding blocks or tokens, so their selection cost per query is $O(L)$ at context length $L$; hierarchical selection reduces it to $O(\log L)$, but prior trainable hierarchical methods report accuracy only within their training length. We propose RecSA (Recursive Sparse Attention), which builds a tree over the KV cache in which each node summarizes its subtree with one key and one mean-pooled value. The keys come from one pooler per layer, shared by all levels and distilled from dense attention. Each level above the tokens selects at most $k$ candidates, so each query has $O(\log L)$ selection cost and reads $O(\log L)$ entries; the summaries of unselected candidates share one softmax with the exact tokens. Each entry's RoPE position is its index among the candidates of its level, so at any length every relative distance stays within the range seen during training. Initialized from Qwen3-4B and trained on 0.62B tokens at the original model's 32K training length, RecSA outperforms all baselines on RULER at every length from 131K to 2M; at 1M, it scores 60.5, compared with 40.0 for the best baseline, Dense + DCA. With our optimized kernels, RecSA is faster than dense attention in end-to-end prefill and decoding from 64K to 2M; at 524K on one H200 GPU, it accelerates prefill by 3.2x and decoding by 3.8x.
papers.title_ja: 再帰的スパースアテンション：対数的コストでの百万トークン長外挿
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、KVキャッシュ上に木構造を構築し、各ノードがサブツリーを1つのキーと平均プーリングされた値で要約する再帰的スパースアテンション（RecSA）を提案する。これにより、クエリごとの選択コストと読み取りコストをO(log L)に削減し、訓練長を超えた長文脈でも高精度な推論を可能にする。Qwen3-4Bをベースに32Kトークンで訓練したモデルが、1Mトークン規模のRULERベンチマークで既存手法を大幅に上回る60.5点を記録した。さらに最適化カーネルにより、64K〜2Mトークン範囲でデンスアテンションより高速なプリフィルとデコーディングを実現し、524Kトークンで3倍以上の高速化を達成した。

papers.title: TriAttention: Unified Sparse Mixed-Precision Attention for Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.summary: Sparsity and quantization reduce the cost of attention by skipping interactions and lowering the precision of those retained. However, useful interactions differ in their precision requirements: some tolerate low-precision scores while remaining sensitive to removal. We therefore introduce TriAttention, which assigns query-key (QK) tiles to skipping, 4-bit, or 8-bit computation, using 4-bit to retain quantization-tolerant interactions at lower cost. To represent compactly, we encode each head's computation regions with two diagonal-distance boundaries, keeping policy storage independent of context length. Offline calibration then evaluates candidate boundary pairs using normalized projected-output errors and complete-tile execution costs. Using these measurements, a model-wide allocator selects each head's boundaries to minimize calibration error under a shared computation budget. During prefill, the selected boundaries generate precision-grouped traversals for a fused kernel that skips omitted tiles and combines contributions from both QK precisions into one normalized attention output. The quantized keys and values prepared during prefill are then reused in a compressed key-value (KV) cache for decoding, reducing repeated reads of prompt data. Experiments show that TriAttention achieves end-to-end generation speedups of up to 7.88x over the Torch attention and 2.65x over the BF16 baseline. Meanwhile, TriAttention maintains quality comparable to the original models on general-purpose and long-context tasks. These results show how a compact retention-and-precision policy translates local sensitivities into attention computation and repeated KV-cache access. The implementation is https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/TriAttention.
papers.title_ja: TriAttention: 長文脈LLM推論のための統合スパース・混合精度アテンション
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、長文脈LLM推論におけるアテンション計算の効率化を目的としたTriAttention手法を提案する。クエリとキーの相互作用の精度要件に応じて、タイル単位でスキップ、4ビット、8ビットの計算を割り当てることで、コスト削減と品質維持を両立させる。オフラインキャリブレーションにより各ヘッドの境界を最適化し、プリフィル段階で生成した量子化済みKVキャッシュをデコーディング時に再利用することで、メモリアクセスを削減する。実験では、Torchアテンション比で最大7.88倍の高速化を実現しつつ、汎用タスクおよび長文脈タスクにおいて元のモデルと同等の品質を維持することを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化・量子化・KVキャッシュ最適化の核心技術

papers.title: Test-Time Self-Play: Scaling without a Verifier
papers.summary: Test-time scaling methods spend additional compute at deployment to improve a large language model's performance on a hard target problem. Most methods rely on a verifier that scores candidate solutions for correctness, using it to select among or refine the model's outputs. In many deployment regimes, however, a strong verifier on the target problem is unavailable. We introduce Test-Time Self-Play (TTSP), an approach to test-time scaling using asymmetric self-play without reliance on a verifier. On a difficulty-calibrated subset of LiveCodeBench v6, TTSP is the best-performing method at every verifier strength we evaluate, and the gap to the strongest baseline widens as the verifier weakens; in the no-verifier limit, TTSP yields a 35\% absolute improvement in mean@8. The gains hold across a range of verifier strengths, except when the base policy has near-zero coverage of the correct answer.
papers.title_ja: テスト時自己対戦：検証者なしでのスケーリング
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、検証者（Verifier）に依存しないテスト時スケーリング手法「Test-Time Self-Play (TTSP)」を提案する。非対称な自己対戦を用いることで、候補解の正誤判定に強い検証者が不要な環境でもLLMのパフォーマンスを向上させる。LiveCodeBench v6での評価において、検証者の強度が弱まるほど既存手法との差が拡大し、検証者なしの条件下では平均精度が35%向上した。ベースモデルが正解を全くカバーしていない場合を除き、幅広い検証者強度で効果が確認された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化・効率化の核心手法であり、ユーザー関心と高度に一致

papers.title: Overcoming Fundamental Control Limitations in Powered Descent Flight through Robust Incremental Nonlinear Dynamic Inversion
papers.summary: This work identifies a fundamental, controller-independent limitation in reusable launch vehicle powered descent: a sudden $180^\circ$ phase transition in the open-loop transfer functions from the control inputs to the lateral drift and drift rate. The transition occurs inside the flight envelope, reverses the effective control direction, and can destabilize the closed loop system under uncertainty. An analytical condition governing this transition is derived, its physical mechanism is established, and its dependence on vehicle mass, aerodynamic properties, and geometry is characterized. An Incremental Nonlinear Dynamic Inversion (INDI)-based control architecture is then developed to inherently address this limitation and is tuned via $\mathcal{H}_\infty$ Closed Loop Shaping to provide local robustness and performance guarantees. The internal dynamics introduced by the INDI inversion are analytically derived and proven to be stable throughout the flight envelope. The proposed controller is compared against a robust gain-scheduled baseline controller through linear stability analysis and an extensive nonlinear Monte Carlo campaign. Both controllers achieve 100% success across the considered Monte Carlo campaign, though the INDI-based controller provides improved tracking performance, superior nominal and dispersed stability margins, requires fewer controller design points, and reduces controller tuning complexity.
papers.title_ja: 強健な増分型非線形動力学逆変換による動力降下飛行における根本的な制御限界の克服
papers.summary_ja: 再利用可能な打ち上げロケットの動力降下において、制御入力から横方向ドリフトへの伝達関数が180度位相転移を起こす根本的な限界を特定した。この転移は制御方向を逆転させ、不確実性下で閉ループ系を不安定化させる可能性がある。本研究では、この限界に対処するため増分型非線形動力学逆変換（INDI）ベースの制御アーキテクチャを提案し、H∞閉ループシェーピングにより強健性を保証した。線形安定性解析と大規模な非線形モンテカルロシミュレーションにより、従来のゲインスケジューリング制御と比較して、INDIベースの制御が追従性能と安定性マージンを向上させ、設計点の削減とチューニングの簡素化を実現することを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 宇宙機の軌道設計・制御最適化に直結する高度な制御理論

papers.title: SteelAgent: LLM-Orchestrated, Physics-Informed Steel Property Prediction with Audited Generalization and Calibrated Uncertainty
papers.summary: Steel property models can perform well on random test splits even when they extrapolate poorly to unfamiliar alloys. SteelAgent couples metallurgical descriptors and machine-learning models with a language-model interface for property prediction, uncertainty reporting and inverse design. We examine how the choice of held-out unit changes the conclusions drawn from SteelBench tensile-strength evaluations. For gradient boosting, pooled out-of-fold $R^2$ fell from 0.859 on a random split to 0.113 when steel families were held out. Empirical coverage of nominal 90% prediction intervals ranged from 91.0% under random splitting to 37.6% on held-out sources. The effect of physics-derived features depended on the evaluation. They increased gradient-boosting $R^2$ by 0.2534 in a 17-family holdout analysis and decreased it by 0.358 in a separate four-grade laboratory analysis. We report group-level errors and a synthetic regression experiment illustrating how calibration can deteriorate on held-out groups. These results motivate reporting the evaluation population alongside a property estimate or compliance score.
papers.title_ja: SteelAgent: LLMオーケストレーションによる物理情報鋼物性予測と監査済み汎化・較正不確実性
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMをインターフェースとして用い、冶金記述子と機械学習モデルを結合した鋼物性予測エージェント「SteelAgent」を提案する。SteelBenchを用いた評価において、ランダム分割では高い精度を示すが、鋼種（ファミリー）単位で保持すると汎化性能が著しく低下し、予測区間の実効カバレッジも大幅に減少することを示した。物理由来の特徴量は評価設定によって効果が逆転し、単一の指標では不十分であることが判明した。これらの結果から、物性評価やコンプライアンス判定において、評価対象集団（population）を併記する重要性を提言している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と物理情報モデル、評価手法の改善が関心に合致

papers.title: PBPO: Prefix-Block Policy Optimization for Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) commonly decode responses by proceeding autoregressively across blocks while iteratively denoising multiple tokens within each block. This structure makes block-level policy optimization a natural adaptation of autoregressive policy optimization. However, the exact likelihood of a completed block is intractable because it marginalizes over the intermediate states and reveal orders of the denoising process. To realize the block-level formulation, we construct a prefix-block state and use a single model evaluation to define a factorized one-step surrogate for the block likelihood. The resulting block surrogate ratio is a product of its token surrogate ratios, allowing variation at individual positions to propagate across the entire block before clipping. We therefore introduce Prefix-Block Policy Optimization (PBPO), which preserves block-level conditioning but applies surrogate importance weighting and clipping separately to each token. PBPO further diversifies repeated updates by resampling corrupted views of the prompt and revealed prefix, a design motivated by masked-dLLM pre-training. Under our analysis assumptions, block-product weighting amplifies the variance of gradient contributions relative to token-local weighting. Across two LLaDA-family initializations, six benchmarks, and three generation lengths, PBPO achieves competitive performance against existing dLLM RL methods.
papers.title_ja: PBPO: 拡散言語モデルのためのプレフィックスブロックポリシー最適化
papers.summary_ja: 拡散型大規模言語モデル（dLLM）におけるブロック単位のポリシー最適化を可能にする手法「PBPO」を提案する。ブロックの尤度計算が困難な問題を解決するため、プレフィックスブロック状態を用いた1ステップのサロゲート尤度を定義し、トークン単位の代理比率の積としてブロック比率を表現する。これにより、ブロック全体の条件付けを維持しつつ、各トークンに対して個別に重要度重み付けとクリッピングを適用できる。LLaDA系モデルを用いた6つのベンチマークで、既存のdLLM強化学習手法と比較して競争力のある性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの推論・学習効率化とRL手法の組み合わせが関心に直結

papers.title: Towards interpreting any residual stream direction by scaling activation inversion
papers.summary: To interpret a direction in a language model's residual stream, we can look for text that strongly activates it. But when such text is found by scanning a corpus, it is limited to what that corpus contains. We develop Maximally-Activating Example Metamodels (MAEMs), language models which map residual stream directions from a subject model to text exemplars that strongly activate those directions. Our objective is to maximise the cosine similarity of a supplied residual stream direction with the activations of the text generated by the MAEM. This label-free RL objective helps to scale MAEMs on diverse sources of residual stream directions. Empirically, we find the resultant metamodel produces informative exemplars: a Qwen3.6-27B MAEM inverts held-out activations better than corpus search or a natural-language autoencoder (NLA), beats corpus search (at 10M tokens) on a majority of held-out languages/domains, and activates 89% of held-out SAE features. It also identifies concepts behind steering vectors about as well as NLAs, recovers the payloads of LoRA backdoors more often than corpus search, and can even verbalise some model workspace inner monologue. Unlike explanations produced by other metamodels (e.g. NLAs), MAEM exemplars can be verified with a forward pass on the subject model, making the MAEM objective a grounded alternative for scaling the training of metamodels.
papers.title_ja: 活性化逆転のスケーリングによる任意の残差ストリーム方向の解釈へ
papers.summary_ja: 言語モデルの残差ストリーム方向を解釈するため、その方向を強く活性化させるテキスト例を生成するメタモデル（MAEM）を提案する。ラベル不要の強化学習目標を用いることで、コーパス検索や自然言語オートエンコーダー（NLA）を超える性能を発揮し、多様な言語やドメインで有効な例示を生成できる。生成された例示は対象モデルのフォワードパスで検証可能であり、解釈の信頼性を高める。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM内部構造の解釈とRL活用は、モデル理解・制御・効率化に直結する重要領域。

papers.title: Rigorously Certified Neural-Network Computation of Nonlinear Water Waves at Near-Machine Precision
papers.summary: We present a computational framework that combines machine-learning-based discovery with rigorous computer-assisted numerical certification and formal verification for strongly nonlinear partial differential equations. We demonstrate the approach for periodic gravity-capillary traveling water waves. Physics-informed neural networks are used as a search mechanism, with the wave profile, wave speed and, in continuation experiments, surface tension learned directly from the governing equations without training data. Through a staged training and refinement procedure, the neural networks achieve near-machine-precision residuals of the governing equations, even in strongly nonlinear regimes. A single formulation recovers high-amplitude Stokes waves, Crapper waves and Wilton ripples. Continuation from a high-amplitude Wilton ripple in surface tension reveals new high-amplitude candidate solutions. We freeze one candidate as an explicit finite representation and rigorously certify a uniform bound on its governing-equation residual using interval arithmetic, accounting for floating-point roundoff, Fourier truncation, aliasing and grid-to-continuum errors. This independently validates the neural-network accuracy. We formalize the certification argument in Lean, which machine-checks the deductions from certified numerical bounds to the residual theorem. Both the interval certification and formalization were developed with substantial assistance from a large language model, while the validity of the result remains independent of the language model: the numerical bounds are rigorously enclosed by interval arithmetic and the subsequent mathematical deductions are checked by the Lean kernel. Together, these steps provide a pipeline from neural discovery to rigorous numerical certification and machine-checked verification with auditable mathematical guarantees.
papers.title_ja: 機械精度に近い厳密な認証による非線形水波のニューラルネットワーク計算
papers.summary_ja: 物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）を用いて非線形偏微分方程式の解を探索し、区間演算による厳密な数値認証とLeanによる形式検証を組み合わせる枠組みを提案する。学習データなしで支配方程式から直接パラメータを学習し、高振幅のStokes波やWilton波などの残差を機械精度に近いレベルまで低減した。区間演算で浮動小数点誤差や切り捨て誤差を考慮した残差の上限を厳密に証明し、その論証をLeanで機械検証することで、ニューラルネットワークの発見から厳密な数学的保証までのパイプラインを実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: PINNと厳密検証の組み合わせは、物理情報モデルの信頼性向上というユーザー関心に直結する。

papers.title: Finite-Time Convergence and Regret Guarantees for Neural Reinforcement Learning in POMDPs
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) in Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) is computationally challenging due to the curse of long-range dependence on history. Fortunately, recent studies have shown that a range of POMDPs that satisfy the filter stability assumption can be well approximated by a superstate Markov Decision Process (MDP) based on a truncated history in a finite-memory window, with a value gap that decays with the window length. However, existing finite-time convergence analyses on such superstate MDP surrogates are either limited to over-simplified linear function approximation or rely on an i.i.d. sampling oracle that is violated by POMDP trajectories, both of which severely limit the applicability of these theoretical results in practice. This motivates us to bridge the gap by investigating RL in POMDPs with nonlinear neural value function approximation. Our main contributions are threefold: i) We first establish a new finite-state MDP point-wise approximation error bound, which lays the foundation for our RL algorithm design and analysis in POMDPs; ii) By applying Temporal-Difference (TD) learning to POMDP-generated superstate transitions and targeting the Bellman fixed point of the superstate MDP, we prove a finite-time critic error bound with nonlinear neural value function approximation; and iii) By combining the neural critic function approximation error bound with the policy mirror descent framework, we obtain a finite-time sublinear regret against the optimal POMDP value. To the best of our knowledge, such a finite-time sublinear regret based on neural function approximation is the first in the literature for finite-memory POMDPs. Our numerical experiments also verify our theoretical results.
papers.title_ja: POMDPにおけるニューラル強化学習の有限時間収束とリグレット保証
papers.summary_ja: 部分観測マルコフ決定過程（POMDP）における強化学習の理論的課題を解決するため、非線形ニューラル価値関数近似を用いた有限時間収束解析を行う。フィルタ安定性仮定を満たすPOMDPを有限メモリ窓に基づくスーパー状態MDPで近似し、その点毎近似誤差の境界を新たに確立する。TD学習とミラー降下法を組み合わせることで、最適POMDP価値に対する有限時間サブ線形リグレット保証を初めて導出した。数値実験により理論結果の妥当性を検証している。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習の理論的保証とニューラルネット近似が関心に合致

papers.title: ShapleyOG: Fast Adaptive Shapley Value Estimation with Odd Gaussian Processes
papers.summary: Shapley values are a central tool for attribution in machine learning. Since their exact computation requires evaluating the cooperative game to be explained on exponentially many player coalitions, they are typically estimated from a limited number of evaluations. Recently, ShaplEIG has shown that adaptively selecting the coalitions to evaluate substantially improves sample efficiency over classical estimators. This, however, comes at the cost of a sequential procedure that, in every iteration, refits a Gaussian process surrogate of the game and selects the coalition with the largest expected information gain about the Shapley values. The resulting computational overhead limits its applicability to costly games with low evaluation budgets. We present fast adaptive Shapley value estimation with Odd Gaussian Processes (ShapleyOG) to overcome this limitation. ShapleyOG leverages the fact that Shapley values depend only on the odd component of the game, and we show that under paired sampling a Gaussian process surrogate on this component alone yields the same Shapley value posterior and coalition selection criterion from half as many observations. Moreover, ShapleyOG refits the surrogate only on a sparse schedule and efficiently updates the selection criterion in between, and it extends quadrature-based computation schemes to the prior covariance of the Shapley values, which allows for exact or cheaper approximate computation. In extensive experiments on diverse games, ShapleyOG matches the estimation accuracy of ShaplEIG while reducing its overhead by up to three orders of magnitude. As a result, it outperforms state-of-the-art non-adaptive estimators at equal total computation time already when a single evaluation takes a tenth of a second and a budget of a few thousand evaluations suffices, thereby widening the regime in which adaptive coalition selection is applicable and pays off.
papers.title_ja: ShapleyOG: 奇数ガウス過程を用いた高速適応型シャプリー値推定
papers.summary_ja: 機械学習の帰属分析におけるシャプリー値の計算コストを大幅に削減する手法「ShapleyOG」を提案する。シャプリー値がゲームの奇数成分のみによって決まる性質を利用し、ペアサンプリング下では半分の観測データで同様の後確率分布と集合選択基準を得られることを示した。さらに、サロゲートモデルの再学習をスパースなスケジュールで行い、選択基準を効率的に更新することで計算オーバーヘッドを最大3桁低減した。実験により、既存の適応型手法と同等の精度を維持しつつ、計算時間を大幅に短縮できることを実証している。
papers.relevance_reason: ガウス過程とサロゲートモデルによる計算高速化が関心に直結

papers.title: TrustMix: Graceful Degradation for Pretrained Models under Distribution Shift
papers.summary: Predicting beyond the training domain necessarily requires assumptions about how the ground truth extrapolates, yet in most neural networks these assumptions are made only implicit through the architecture. We propose TrustMix, a lightweight post-hoc method that makes a pretrained model's extrapolative behaviour explicit and controllable. TrustMix combines the predictive distribution produced by a pretrained model with a user-specified fallback distribution $p_0(y|x)$, such that as the out-of-distribution (OOD) deviation statistic grows, we collapse towards $p_0(y|x)$. TrustMix provides graceful degradation: the predictive distribution converges toward the fallback distribution as the OOD signal grows. The fallback distribution $p_0(y|x)$ can reflect domain knowledge, if available, or rely on a domain-agnostic stationarity assumption. TrustMix does not require retraining of the base model and can be applied to both regression and classification problems. We evaluated TrustMix on several synthetic and real-world distribution shifts, including tabular, image, and natural language processing tasks. We tested TrustMix on datasets such as CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet and on numerous architectures including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Transformers. TrustMix remains competitive in-distribution while improving predictive uncertainty under distribution shift, with gains in predictive likelihood for regression and calibration for classification. Finally, we showed that TrustMix can provide useful predictive distributions for decision-making applications by utilizing it as a surrogate for Bayesian Optimisation.
papers.title_ja: TrustMix: 分布シフト下での事前学習モデルのグレースフル・デグラデーション
papers.summary_ja: TrustMixは、事前学習モデルの推論挙動を明示的に制御し、分布外（OOD）データに対して予測分布をユーザー指定のフォールバック分布へ滑らかに収束させる軽量な事後処理手法である。ベースモデルの再学習を必要とせず、回帰・分類の両方に適用可能で、OOD検出統計量に基づいて信頼度を調整する。CIFAR-10/100やImageNet、NLPタスクなど多様なデータセットで、分布内性能を維持しつつ分布シフト時の予測不確実性やキャリブレーションを改善することを示した。さらに、ベイズ最適化のサロゲートモデルとして活用することで、意思決定アプリケーションにおける予測分布の有用性を検証している。
papers.relevance_reason: ベイズ最適化のサロゲートモデル応用と、ML手法全般の効率化・信頼性向上に直結するため。

papers.title: Fractional physics-informed neural networks to model social media virality
papers.summary: Existing models of social media virality either prescribe the functional form of engagement growth or assume a fixed mechanism by which past activity influences future engagement. We present a fractional physics-informed neural network that learns both the temporal memory and nonlinear growth dynamics of social media engagement, using symbolic regression to translate the learned dynamics into interpretable equations. Synthetic experiments at the deployment resolution of 24 hourly observations demonstrate that the fractional order and reaction law can be jointly recovered from clean data. Under observation noise, however, the standard pointwise physics residual drives the fractional order toward its lower bound through a scale artifact. We address this failure using a fully whitened residual that propagates observation noise through the fractional operator. Applying the framework to 348 posts from X (formerly Twitter), we find that a single-window model estimates strongly memory-dependent dynamics but fails to accurately reconstruct held-out trajectories. Partitioning the 24-hour window into four teacher-forced segments substantially improves performance, yielding segment-specific fractional orders that increase from 0.23 to 0.99 and interpretable growth laws for each phase. The segmented model reconstructs 64% of held-out trajectories within a mean squared error of 0.01, compared with 44% for the strongest of nine classical baselines. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of fractional physics-informed equation discovery to uncover interpretable engagement dynamics while highlighting the importance of noise-aware estimation and temporal segmentation.
papers.title_ja: ソーシャルメディアのバイラル性をモデル化する分数階物理情報ニューラルネットワーク
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、ソーシャルメディアのエンゲージメント成長をモデル化するために、分数階微分方程式と物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）を統合した手法を提案する。観測ノイズに対する頑健性を高めるため、分数演算子を通じてノイズを伝播させる完全ホワイト化残差法を導入し、標準的な点毎物理残差によるバイアスを解消した。X（旧Twitter）の348件の投稿データへの適用では、24時間ウィンドウを4分割して教師強制学習を行うことで、時間変化する分数階数（0.23〜0.99）と解釈可能な成長法則を推定し、古典的ベースラインを上回る予測精度（MSE 0.01以内で64%の軌道再構成）を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットと分数階微分方程式というユーザー関心と高度に一致する手法を提案しているため。

papers.title: Projection-based segregated, iterative, and multi-stage physics-informed neural network for incompressible Navier-stokes equations
papers.summary: Physics-informed neural networks(PINNs) offer a mesh-free and continuously differentiable approach to fluid simulation. However, standard monolithic PINNs for incompressible Navier-Stokes (NS) equations often suffer from severe constraint coupling and spectral biases, limiting both convergence and accuracy. To address this challenge, we propose a segregated, iterative, and multi-stage PINN (SIM-PINN) inspired by the classical projection method in computational fluid dynamics. In SIM-PINN, the nonlinear NS equations are decoupled into the linearized momentum and pressure Poisson equations. Each is addressed separately using dedicated multi-stage neural networks and coupled through projection-based inner iterations. Each stage of the multi-stage neural networks for the momentum equations corresponds to one iteration of the projection method, in which the velocity fields are progressively refined at targeted frequencies. Upon iteration convergence, solutions to the fully coupled and nonlinear NS equations are recovered. By integrating the segregated and iterative framework with the multi-stage training, SIM-PINN alleviates the optimization difficulties of the incompressible NS equations arising from nonlinearity, constraint coupling, and spectral biases. The improved convergence and accuracy are demonstrated by simulations of steady lid-driven cavity and unsteady Kolmogorov flows.
papers.title_ja: 非圧縮性ナビエ・ストークス方程式のための射影ベースの分離型・反復型・多段階物理情報ニューラルネットワーク
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、非圧縮性ナビエ・ストークス方程式の解法として、古典的な射影法に着想を得たSIM-PINNを提案する。単一ネットワークによる解法が抱える制約結合やスペクトルバイアスの問題を解決するため、運動量方程式と圧力ポアソン方程式を分離し、それぞれに専用の多段階ニューラルネットワークを適用する。各段階で速度場を段階的に洗練させることで、非線形性や最適化の困難さを緩和し、収束性と精度を向上させる。定常リッド駆動キャビティ流や非定常コルモゴロフ流のシミュレーションにより、その有効性を検証している。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネット（PINN）の手法改良であり、ユーザーの関心領域に直接該当する。

papers.title: Conformal Prediction for Time-Dependent PDEs
papers.summary: Uncertainty quantification is crucial in scientific machine learning, where models inform safety-critical tasks such as flood forecasting, financial risk management, and thermal control in machines. Conformal prediction provides distribution-free coverage guarantees, but in time-dependent settings common to physics and engineering, these guarantees can break down, leading to systematic undercoverage. We study this problem in the context of surrogate models for time-dependent physical systems described by partial differential equations. We prove that in a function space setting, distributions at arbitrarily close times can be mutually singular, making exact coverage guarantees impossible. We further show that in discretized settings, the total variation distance between distributions often saturates exponentially fast with the grid resolution, mandating restrictions on the spatial discretization to ensure coverage. Finally, for certain settings, we show how to use principled weighted conformal prediction to obtain finite-sample coverage guarantees over growing time horizons.
papers.title_ja: 時間依存偏微分方程式における適合予測
papers.summary_ja: 時間依存PDEによる物理システムのサロゲートモデルにおいて、適合予測（Conformal Prediction）の保証が崩壊する問題を研究する。関数空間では近接時刻の分布が互いに特異になり得るため、厳密なカバレッジ保証は不可能であることを証明した。離散化設定では、空間離散化の制限なしにはカバレッジを確保できないことを示し、特定の条件下では重み付き適合予測を用いて有限サンプルでのカバレッジ保証を得る手法を提案する。

papers.title: The Power of Meta Access in the Software of the Future --- Demonstrated on LLM Chat UIs and Chat AI
papers.summary: Chat remains the default surface for many large language model (LLM) tasks, even as agentic tools such as OpenCode excel at coding and automation. Yet the model sees the current dialogue but not the workspace around it. We explore meta access---giving the assistant a structured, permissioned view of the interface itself and propose a ladder of levels: feature tutoring; metadata, settings, and preference access; retrieval over summaries and messages, confirmed mutation, and full orchestration. Meta access can turn a chat client from many screens into one entry point for finding, navigating, organising, and operating it, while raising risks around grounding, privacy, prompt injection, and trust. General-purpose agentic harnesses are runtimes; because they can change their own settings, meta access becomes reflexive and needs a separate control-plane boundary. We ground this in the Meta Chat prototype of the Chat AI client. It builds bounded context from, e.g., summaries, settings, and relevant messages; links references to conversations, topics, and personas; supports confirmed, reversible changes; offers a browsable tutorial library; and recommends personas as user-started conversations. By exposing application state in structured form, meta access can extend screen readers from widget descriptions to semantic workspace operations. Meta access thus turns chat from a window onto one conversation into a control layer for the whole workspace, extending chat toward agentic capability without surrendering user control. As assistants become embedded in IDEs, dashboards, office suites, and operating systems, AI-era interfaces should expose a structured, permissioned model of their state and capabilities, ideally by opening their existing metamodels through a debugger-like interface.
papers.title_ja: 未来のソフトウェアにおけるメタアクセスの力 --- LLMチャットUIとチャットAIでの実証
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMが対話履歴だけでなく、インターフェース自体の状態や設定に構造化された権限付きアクセス（メタアクセス）を持つことを提案する。これにより、チャットクライアントは単なる会話窓口から、ワークスペース全体の検索・操作・オーケストレーションを行う制御レイヤーへと進化し、エージェント機能の拡張が可能になる。具体的には、設定変更やメッセージ操作を可逆的かつ確認付きで行うプロトタイプを実装し、プライバシーやプロンプトインジェクションなどのリスク管理の重要性も論じる。AI時代には、IDEやOSなどへの埋め込みを想定し、アプリケーションの状態をデバッガのようなインターフェースで公開する設計が不可欠であると結論づけている。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計とUI制御の統合という、ユーザーの関心領域に直結する手法を提案しているため。

papers.title: Capturing Membrane Dynamics and Spike Timing of Human Neurons at Scale using Neural Operators
papers.summary: Characterizing the properties of neuronal cell types is central to understanding brain function. Yet, biophysically realistic neuron models remain difficult to scale to large populations while preserving the richness of cellular dynamics and within-cell-type variability. We present a cell-type-specific neural-operator framework for scalable neuronal population modeling. Rather than training separate surrogate models for individual neurons, the proposed framework learns a shared operator across multiple modeled neurons from the same cell type, conditioned on biologically interpretable electrophysiological features. Relative to the original single-neuron \texttt{NOBLE} setting, learning across heterogeneous neurons requires a richer electrophysiological conditioning representation and a training objective designed to preserve diverse spiking dynamics. This enables efficient generation of large ensembles of somatic voltage responses while preserving variability across cells and model configurations. We evaluate the approach using membrane dynamics metrics, action potential waveform metrics, spike timing accuracy, input-output firing relationships, and electrophysiological feature distributions. Our framework reproduces subthreshold membrane dynamics, spike waveforms, and firing-rate responses across major cortical inhibitory neuron types, while accurately preserving spike timing despite the sensitivity of threshold-crossing dynamics. The predicted electrophysiological feature distributions show strong agreement with detailed simulator outputs and human experimental recordings, including high explained variability in properties such as inter-spike intervals, firing frequency, action-potential shape, and post-spike recovery.
papers.title_ja: ニューラルオペレータを用いた大規模ヒトニューロンの膜動態とスパイクタイミングの捕捉
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、細胞型特異的なニューラルオペレータフレームワークを提案し、大規模なニューロン集団のモデリングを可能にする。個々のニューロンごとにサロゲートモデルを訓練するのではなく、同じ細胞型の複数のニューロン間で共有されるオペレータを学習し、生物学的に解釈可能な電気生理学的特徴を条件として用いる。これにより、細胞間の変動性を保ちつつ、膜動態、スパイク波形、発火率応答を効率的に生成できる。詳細シミュレータや実験データとの比較により、スパイクタイミングの精度や電気生理学的特徴の分布が高精度で再現されることを示した。

papers.title: Estimating Spectrum-Free Information Bounds for Generative Surrogates Beyond Conditional Collapse
papers.summary: Conditional generative surrogates in high-energy physics, such as models that predict reconstructed jets from partons, are often evaluated on $1\text{D}$ marginal divergences among other metrics. Taken alone these metrics can reward conditional collapse. On a CMS simulation benchmark, a sampler that ignores the conditioner beats a trained Mixture Density Network (MDN) on all four target marginals under both KL and Wasserstein-1, and cannot be stably separated from a Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) model on two of the four. We instead score the models with the Continuous Ranked Probability Skill Score (CRPSS) from forecast verification, taking the exact marginal as the reference. We show how global skill depends on the evaluation spectrum, and we also report it within bins of a conditioning variable, where that dependence largely goes away. We then introduce a data-driven $k$-Nearest-Neighbor ($k$-NN) extrapolation that estimates the best CRPS the conditioning information allows. Both models agree with this estimate on all four targets, which suggests that current architectures have reached the information available in the conditioner, at least as far as these per-target scores can tell.
papers.title_ja: 条件崩壊を越えた生成サロゲートのスペクトルフリー情報限界の推定
papers.summary_ja: 高エネルギー物理における条件付き生成サロゲートの評価において、従来の周辺分布の発散度のみでは「条件崩壊」（条件情報を無視しても高スコアになる現象）を適切に検出できない問題を指摘する。予測検証の手法であるCRPSSを用い、評価スペクトルとスキルスコアの関係を分析した。さらに、条件変数が許す最大のCRPSを推定するデータ駆動型k-NN外挿法を提案し、現在のモデルが条件情報から得られる情報限界に達していることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルの評価手法と情報限界の定量化が関心に直結

papers.title: Physics-informed latent conditional flow matching for generative modeling of granular flows on inclined planes
papers.summary: The internal kinematic and mechanical states of granular flows are difficult to observe or measure, limiting the interpretation of internal particle interactions and their role in flow evolution. In this study, we propose a physics-informed latent conditional flow matching (PI-LCFM) framework for reconstructing complete multivariable flow sequences from partial boundary observations. A variational autoencoder and temporal flow-matching model learn a reusable latent prior over velocity, granular temperature, stress, and solid volume fraction. During inference, boundary-velocity or basal-stress observations and mass- and momentum-conservation constraints guide the latent trajectory through the decoded physical fields, without retraining either model. The results demonstrate that the model accurately reconstructs full spatiotemporal fields from observations containing only 0.3\% of the complete field information, extrapolates beyond the training ranges of inclination and particle number, and recovers key trends in runout scaling, energy evolution, and stress profiles. Compared with a frame-by-frame conditional flow-matching baseline, PI-LCFM reduces the mean velocity-component root-mean-square error by 45.2\%, while observation-guided reconstruction of 500-frame sequences achieves an approximately 44-fold speedup. Physics guidance further improves conservation consistency, supporting the broader potential of this framework for inferring hidden states in particulate systems, with potential applications envisioned in geophysical hazard assessment and industrial process monitoring.
papers.title_ja: 傾斜面における粒状流の生成モデリングのための物理情報潜在条件付きフローマッチング
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、粒状流の内部状態を部分的な境界観測から再構成する物理情報潜在条件付きフローマッチング（PI-LCFM）フレームワークを提案する。変分オートエンコーダと時間フローマッチングモデルを用いて、速度や応力などの物理量を含む潜在空間を学習し、質量・運動量保存則などの物理制約を推論時に適用することで、再学習なしに高精度な場を復元する。実験では、完全場のわずか0.3%の情報から時空間場を再構成し、ベースライン比で誤差を45.2%低減するとともに、500フレームの再構成において約44倍の高速化を実現した。この手法は、地質災害評価や産業プロセス監視における隠れ状態の推定に応用可能である。

papers.title: LithoSAGE: Spatially Adaptive and Geometrically Equivariant Neural Operators for Computational Lithography
papers.summary: Operator learning offers an efficient surrogate for lithography simulation, replacing costly numerical solutions with direct model inference. However, existing learning architectures are not designed to simultaneously provide geometric equivariance and adaptability to layout windows with different physical extents, and thus their generalization capability is limited. To address this problem, we propose LithoSAGE, a spatially adaptive and geometrically equivariant neural operator method trained on lithography data. Within its basic Fourier neural operator architecture, spectral weights are expressed as continuous functions of normalized radial frequency through a learnable sum of Gaussians. This representation preserves the geometric properties of the lithography system and incorporates rotation and translation equivariance, spatial interaction decay, and direct evaluation on different layout windows. Experiments predict aerial images from mask layouts and resist images from aerial images, demonstrating the geometric equivariance and spatial adaptivity of LithoSAGE. Comparisons with other architectures also assess prediction errors and parameter efficiency.
papers.title_ja: LithoSAGE: 計算リソグラフィのための空間適応型かつ幾何学的等変性を持つニューラルオペレータ
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、リソグラフィシミュレーションの高速化を目的としたサロゲートモデル「LithoSAGE」を提案する。既存の学習アーキテクチャが持つ幾何学的等変性の欠如と、異なる物理的範囲を持つレイアウトウィンドウへの適応性の低さを解決するため、Fourier Neural Operator の枠組み内でスペクトル重みを学習可能なガウス関数の和として表現する手法を採用した。これにより、回転・並進の等変性や空間相互作用の減衰を保持しつつ、異なるサイズのレイアウトに対して直接評価可能となる。実験では、マスクレイアウトからエアリアルイメージ、エアリアルイメージからレジストイメージへの予測において、他のアーキテクチャと比較して予測誤差とパラメータ効率の両面で優れた性能を示した。

papers.title: Symmetry-Aware Surrogate-Assisted Testing of UAVs
papers.summary: We investigate a symmetry-aware surrogate-assisted testing approach for UAV autopilots. The proposed approach exploits geometric symmetries between flight missions by trans- forming obstacle configurations into a shared canonical coordi- nate frame. This enables a neural-network surrogate trained on a single reference mission to be reused across arbitrary missions, reducing the amount of high-fidelity simulation data required for training. The surrogate model is trained to predict the minimum clearance distance between a UAV and surrounding obstacles and is used to guide test generation towards safety-critical scenarios. We evaluate this approach using the Aerialist UAV test bench and benchmark its performance against techniques from the 2024 to 2026 UAV Testing Competitions. Results show that the approach achieves an average critical-test-case hit rate of 42% across the evaluated missions, compared with approximately 10% for the constrained-random baseline used to generate the training data. This approach also achieves high input diversity and competitive benchmark performance. However, our findings reveal limitations in transferring surrogate predictions across missions with differing flight-path characteristics, highlighting the boundaries of geometric canonicalization. To support reproducibility and future research, we provide the trained surrogate model and a dataset comprising more than 2,500 high-fidelity simulations.
papers.title_ja: UAVの対称性認識サロゲート支援テスト
papers.summary_ja: UAVオートパイロットのテストにおいて、飛行ミッション間の幾何学的対称性を活用し、障害物設定を共通の正規座標系に変換する手法を提案する。これにより、単一の参照ミッションで訓練したニューラルネットワークサロゲートモデルを任意のミッションに再利用でき、高忠実度シミュレーションデータの必要量を削減する。このモデルはUAVと障害物の最小クリアランス距離を予測し、安全性に重要なシナリオへのテスト生成を導く。評価の結果、ベースラインと比較してクリティカルテストケースのヒット率が大幅に向上したが、飛行経路特性が異なるミッション間での予測転移には限界があることも明らかになった。

papers.title: Reduced-order modeling of squeeze-film damped electrostatically actuated microbeams using complex modes of the coupled problem
papers.summary: A reduced-order model is developed for the nonlinear dynamics of electrostatically actuated microbeams, including the full squeeze film effect. The model uses Petrov-Galerkin projection on damped complex modes of the fully coupled fluid-structure problem. The Euler-Bernoulli theory for calmped-clamped and clamped-free microbeams, with mid-plane stretching and electrostatic nonlinearities, and the nonlinear compressible Reynolds equation are discretized by the differential quadrature method for the static solution and eigenvalue problem. The calculated eigenmodes are either complex conjugates describing the coupled behavior of the device or real depicting the fluid relaxation. The natural frequencies and quality factors are compared to experimental and numerical results found in the literature. Depending on the ambient pressure, the geometry of the microbeam, and the fluid boundary conditions, squeeze-film effect can impact not only the effective damping of the device but also its dynamics. It is shown that in some cases dropping fluid relaxation modes cannot be compensated by any set of purely structural modes. The non-classical damping introduced by the fluid modes is a spatially distributed phase difference between pressure and deflection. The convergence analysis of the dynamic response resulting from the reduced-order model showed that a basis with one set of coupled modes and one fluid mode can reproduce the results of a fully discretized model within 1.5% error and at much faster computational time.
papers.title_ja: 複合問題の複素モードを用いたスクイーズフィルム減衰を伴う静電駆動マイクロビームの縮約モデリング
papers.summary_ja: 静電駆動マイクロビームの非線形動的挙動において、フルスクイーズフィルム効果を考慮した縮約モデルを構築した。Petrov-Galerkin投影法を用い、流体-構造結合問題の減衰複素モードを基底として採用することで、従来の純粋な構造モードでは再現できない非古典的減衰特性を捉える。収束解析の結果、結合モード1組と流体モード1つを含む基底により、完全離散化モデルの結果を1.5%の誤差以内で再現しつつ、計算時間を大幅に短縮できることを示した。

papers.title: Stochastic Dynamics of Generative AI: From Autoregressive Models to Interacting LLM Networks and Neural SDEs
papers.summary: This paper develops a stochastic dynamical-systems perspective on three classes of generative AI models. First, we formulate large language models (LLMs) as high-dimensional nonlinear autoregressive models with attention-based dependencies. This formulation connects pretraining by conditional maximum likelihood to sequential token generation and provides a probabilistic interpretation of LLM operation. Second, we consider networks of interacting LLMs and characterize their collective behavior through mean-field ordinary differential equations. These dynamics provide a framework for understanding emergent preferential attachment and persistent structural biases, including type-dependent glass-ceiling effects. Third, we consider neural stochastic differential equations (SDEs) as continuous-time generative models for stochastic trajectories, including those observed at irregular time intervals. We discuss their training with particular emphasis on Wiener-space cubature methods based on rough-path analysis as an efficient alternative to Monte Carlo estimation. Together, the three settings address probabilistic prediction, information exchange and emergent behavior in interacting networks, and path-space generative modeling.
papers.title_ja: 生成AIの確率動的系：自己回帰モデルから相互作用するLLMネットワーク、そしてニューラルSDEへ
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、大規模言語モデル（LLM）を高次元非線形自己回帰モデルとして定式化し、事前学習とトークン生成の確率的解釈を提示する。さらに、相互作用するLLMネットワークの集団挙動を平均場常微分方程式で特徴付け、優先的付着や構造バイアスの創発を分析する。最後に、不規則な時間間隔の確率軌道に対する連続時間生成モデルとしてニューラル確率微分方程式（SDE）を扱い、粗経路解析に基づくウィーナー空間立方体法による効率的な訓練手法を提案する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの理論的基盤と、推論効率化に直結するSDE訓練手法を網羅

papers.title: Server-Side Sparse Assignment for Federated Mixture-of-Experts
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly recognized for their remarkable capabilities; federated learning (FL) offers a promising framework for collaboratively fine-tuning LLMs on edge devices while achieving data privacy. However, edge devices are inherently heterogeneous: clients may exhibit diverse data distributions and resource constraints, including limited memory and computation budgets. Recent federated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approaches address these challenges by using sparse expert activation or partial expert loading. However, existing partial-expert methods rely on heuristic full-pool observations or prioritize system-wide load balance, without guarantees for recovering client-specific relevant experts from partial observations. We propose $S^3$-MoE, a server-side sparse expert assignment framework that estimates client-specific expert relevance from partial observations and refines assignments through an exploit--explore mechanism. We also establish relevance-estimation error and exact Top-$K$ recovery guarantees. Experiments using a CNN-based MoE on CIFAR-100 show that $S^3$-MoE recovers task-dependent client--expert preferences and reduces conflicts caused by correlated expert selection across clients. Compared with Full-20 FedAvg, which gives each client access to all 20 experts for local Top-5 routing, $S^3$-MoE achieves 1.31 percentage points higher mean final accuracy while loading only $5$ experts per client.
papers.title_ja: 連邦学習におけるMixture-of-Expertsのサーバーサイドスパース割り当て
papers.summary_ja: エッジデバイス上のLLM微調整において、クライアント固有のデータ分布やリソース制約を考慮した連邦学習フレームワークを提案する。既存手法が部分的な観測からクライアント関連のエキスパートを確実に復元できない問題を解決するため、部分観測から関連性を推定し、エクスプロイト・エクスプローメカニズムで割り当てを改善するS^3-MoEを設計した。関連性推定誤差とTop-K復元保証を理論的に確立し、実験では全エキスパートにアクセスする手法より少ないエキスパートロードで高い精度を達成したことを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化と推論高速化、および分散学習の最適化手法に関わるため

papers.title: A Night at the LLM Zoo: Data Conditioned Flow Matching for Generating Pretrained LLM Weights
papers.summary: A challenge to Weight Space Learning as it expands from task specific and vision models to Large Language Models (LLMs) is the absence of a well curated and analyzed LLM population. To address this, we train such a model zoo for application to Weight Space Generation by systematically varying the data mixture composition between web text, books, mathematics, coding, and French across populations of 51M, 124M, and 355M parameter GPT-2 Models, each tier with count N = 100. We analyze these populations by cosine similarity, functional diversity, Leave-One-Mixture-Out modeling, and variance decomposition. We show that the zoo contains diverse models whose variation is structured by training mixture composition. We embed the training mixture composition to condition a Flow Matching model of complete pretrained LLM weights in Gram-PCA compressed weight space. By demonstrating zero-shot generalization to held out mixtures, measuring Continuous Ranked Probability Score skill, as well as finding minimal changes in downstream test-set perplexity and general capability benchmark scores, we show that our generator generalizes on the simplex of data mixtures to produce models that perform similarly to those in the zoo ex nihilo. Finally, we produce all source code and artifacts to support the continued expansion of Weight Space Learning and Generation into the LLM domain.
papers.title_ja: LLM動物園の一夜：事前学習済みLLM重みの生成のためのデータ条件付きフローマッチング
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、データ混合比を系統的に変えて訓練したGPT-2モデル群（51M〜355Mパラメータ）を構築し、重み空間における多様性と構造を分析した。訓練データ混合比を条件変数として、Gram-PCA圧縮された重み空間でフローマッチングモデルを学習し、事前学習済みLLMの重みを生成する手法を提案する。未知のデータ混合比に対するゼロショット汎化性能を検証し、生成モデルが既存モデルと同等のパフォーマンスを持つことを示した。
