papers.title: PromptOps: Iterative Prompt Optimization for LLM-as-a-Judge Systems
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for evaluating the behavior of chatbots and other AI systems. In deployment, however, their agreement with the intended human evaluation policy may degrade as user interactions and score distributions change. Existing automatic prompt optimization methods are primarily studied as one-shot procedures on static development sets and therefore provide limited guidance for maintaining LLM judges over time. We frame this problem as judge drift and introduce PromptOps, a closedloop framework for monitoring and iteratively recalibrating LLM-as-a-Judge (LLMaaJ) systems. PromptOps separates four operational decisions: when to optimize, which optimization procedure to apply, which feedback records to use, and how to update the judge prompt. We instantiate the framework with five prompt optimization methods: GEPA, SIMBA, Rubric Synthesis, and exemplar selection using either simulated annealing or a Tree-structured Parzen Estimator. Our experiments demonstrate that iterative prompt optimization can recalibrate LLM judges and recover performance after controlled shifts in the referencescore distribution. However, effective maintenance is inherently contextdependent: neither optimization algorithm choice nor update timing generalizes universally across settings. These findings establish prompt optimization for deployed LLM judges as an inherently iterative maintenance problem and demonstrate that PromptOps provides a practical abstraction for studying and implementing this process.
papers.title_ja: PromptOps: LLM-as-a-Judge システムのための反復プロンプト最適化
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLM を評価者として利用する際の「ジャッジドリフト」問題に対処するための閉ループフレームワーク PromptOps を提案する。既存の一発型プロンプト最適化とは異なり、最適化のタイミング、手法、フィードバックデータ、プロンプト更新方法を分離し、運用中の性能劣化を監視・再調整する。GEPA や SIMBA、ツリー構造パーゼン推定器を用いた例示選択など 5 つの最適化手法を実装し、参照スコア分布の変化に対する性能回復を実証した。ただし、最適なアルゴリズムやタイミングは文脈依存であり、普遍的な一般化は困難であることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM 評価・ハルシネーション対策とベイズ最適化手法の応用が関心に合致

papers.title: Archetypal contexts in the neurons of language models: an architecture for intelligence?
papers.summary: We validate our previous hypothesis that a language model holds relational patterns apart from the subject domains that instantiate them (Nordfors, 2026). These archetypal contexts are patterns of relations that people recognize across many fields, such as the tipping point or winner takes all, held once and applied across domains. We show this inside the model, Qwen3.8-27B. One set of neurons carries the archetype, say the tipping point; another carries the topic, say politics, ecology or cell biology; a third carries the language, such as English, Spanish or Chinese. Silence the tipping point's neurons, and the model no longer identifies the pattern but still knows what the text is about. Silence the topic's, and it loses the topic but still names the pattern. In the neuron maps the layers organize themselves into a sandwich: the outer layers carry languages, the layers inside them topics, the layers at the heart archetypes. The sandwich emerges spontaneously during pretraining and appears in every model we mapped. Archetypes are the architecture for analogy, and we strongly suggest that this structure of archetypes and topics is the mechanism of a language model's intelligence: we see it self-organize as the model is trained. The neurons, the texts and the code are released with this paper as its reproduction package, so that anyone can repeat the test inside the model.
papers.title_ja: 言語モデルのニューロンにおける原型コンテキスト：知性のためのアーキテクチャか？
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、大規模言語モデル（LLM）が特定の領域を超えた関係性パターン（原型コンテキスト）を独立して保持していることを検証する。Qwen3.8-27Bを用いた解析により、ニューロンが「原型」「トピック」「言語」の3層構造（サンドイッチ構造）を自発的に形成していることが示された。各層のニューロンをサイレンシングすることで、パターン認識能力とトピック理解能力が分離して失われることを確認し、この構造が類推や知性のメカニズムである可能性を提唱する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの内部構造解明と推論メカニズムの理解に直結する重要な知見

papers.title: $D^2$-OPD: Separating Direction and Distance in Extrapolative On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model to match a teacher's next-token distributions on student-generated prefixes. Extrapolative OPD further extends the teacher's log-probability shift relative to a reference policy to construct stronger learning targets. However, existing methods couple extrapolation direction and distance, allowing the magnitude of the teacher's shift to dictate how far the target moves. We propose $D^2$-OPD, decoupling these two factors: a per-prefix hard KL constraint bounds the target's distance from the teacher, while an adaptive combination of the teacher's post-training shift and the initial student--teacher gap determines the extrapolation direction. We optimize the student toward this target using forward KL, providing learning signals even for low-probability tokens. We evaluate three settings: where standard OPD performs well, where it struggles with base-model initialization, and where no teacher reference is available. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks, $D^2$-OPD attains the highest score in all three settings, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 9.45 points. Ablations validate the contributions of each component.
papers.title_ja: D^2-OPD：外挿的オンポリシー蒸留における方向と距離の分離
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、教師モデルの分布を学生モデルに転移するオンポリシー蒸留（OPD）手法の改良を提案する。既存手法が外挿の方向と距離を結合させていた問題に対し、KL制約で距離を制限し、教師のシフトと初期ギャップから方向を決定するD^2-OPDを設計した。これにより低確率トークンへの学習シグナルも提供し、数学推論ベンチマークにおいて既存ベースラインを最大9.45点上回る性能を達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの蒸留・効率化と推論性能向上に直結する手法

papers.title: WeightLoop: Weight-Space Programming with Experimental Feedback
papers.summary: Weight-space programming (WSP) shows that language models can reason about and rewrite neural network weights; recursive self-improvement (RSI) motivates feedback-driven improvement. Models guiding experiments receive concrete feedback: completed assays reveal prediction errors and inform what to test next. We introduce WeightLoop, a framework that turns experimental feedback into persistent updates to deployed predictors. GPT-6 Astra inspects a task specification and the model implementation, then writes a bounded, reusable parameter-editing program. As new measurements arrive, the program identifies prediction discrepancies, validates candidate edits using observed outcomes, and writes the selected changes back to the original model. The editor remains fixed while the predictor evolves, enabling repeated updates without further LLM calls or gradient retraining while preserving the original inference interface. In offline replay, targeted edits improve mean ranking utility in seven of eight endpoint-budget settings (all eight versus random edits) and mean final discovery across three sequential tasks. WeightLoop connects WSP with an RSI-inspired improvement loop, making experimental evidence a direct driver of model change and subsequent decisions.
papers.title_ja: WeightLoop: 実験フィードバックを用いた重み空間プログラミング
papers.summary_ja: WeightLoopは、LLMがニューラルネットワークの重みを直接編集し、実験フィードバックに基づいてモデルを継続的に改善するフレームワークである。GPT-6 Astraがタスク仕様と実装を解析し、再利用可能なパラメータ編集プログラムを生成する。新しい測定値が入ると、予測誤差を検出し、検証済みの編集を元のモデルに書き戻すことで、勾配学習や追加のLLM呼び出しなしに推論インターフェースを保ったままモデルを進化させる。オフラインリプレイ実験では、ランダム編集と比較してランキング効用や発見率が向上し、実験証拠をモデル変更の直接駆動源とする手法の有効性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMによるモデル自己改善・効率化と、実験フィードバック活用というユーザー関心に直結する手法。

papers.title: Rethinking Data Selection: The Importance of Coverage over Difficulty in LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.summary: Selecting high-quality training data can reduce computation cost for LLM fine-tuning. Prior work on data selection developed a variety of difficulty-based scores, motivated by the intuition that harder examples are more informative. While effective for smaller classification models, we find that such methods often fail to outperform random selection for LLM fine-tuning. Our analysis reveals that random selection performs better because it is more representative of the underlying input space---i.e., has better coverage. To validate the importance of coverage, we implement a simple clustering-based selection method which selects data that is more representative of the underlying input distribution. On a set of diverse single-domain tasks, this method yields performance at or above that of random selection. On the diverse, multi-domain T\"{u}lu 3 mixture, where random sampling no longer guarantees a balanced subset, our method outperforms all methods. Overall, our results indicate that prioritizing coverage over difficulty leads to more effective data selection for LLM fine-tuning.
papers.title_ja: LLMファインチューニングにおけるデータ選択の再考：難易度よりカバレッジが重要
papers.summary_ja: LLMのファインチューニングにおいて、従来の「難しい例ほど情報量が高い」という難易度ベースのデータ選択手法は、ランダム選択に勝てないことが多いことを示した。分析の結果、ランダム選択が優れる理由は入力空間のカバレッジ（代表性）が高いためであることが判明した。そこで、入力分布をより代表するデータを抽出するクラスタリングベースの選択手法を提案した。単一ドメインタスクではランダム選択と同等以上の性能を示し、多ドメイン混合データセットでは既存手法をすべて上回る結果を得た。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMファインチューニングの効率化とデータ選択戦略に直結する

papers.title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Epigraph-Form Guided Exploration
papers.summary: Discovering cooperative behavior in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is challenging due to the combinatorial complexity of joint state-action spaces, which hinders the emergence of coordinated behaviors from trial-and-error alone. Intrinsic rewards are often used to aid discovery, but naively combining them with team objectives can distort the learning signal, compromising task performance. In this paper, we propose EFXPLORER, a constrained exploration framework that maximizes exploration objectives subject to a constraint that preserves established task performance. We solve the resulting problem using an epigraph reformulation that introduces adaptive exploration budgets. This approach separates intrinsic rewards from task objectives and regulates exploration through task feasibility. To further encourage diverse and temporally extended exploration, we incorporate a successor distance-based intrinsic reward that captures long-horizon dependencies. Empirically, our method outperforms strong baselines and induces novel cooperative strategies across SMAX, VMAS, and MPE benchmark suites.
papers.title_ja: エピグラフ形式による探索ガイダンスを用いた協調型マルチエージェント強化学習
papers.summary_ja: マルチエージェント強化学習（MARL）における協調行動の発見を、タスク性能を維持する制約付き探索フレームワーク「EFXPLORER」によって実現する手法を提案する。エピグラフ変換を用いて適応的な探索予算を導入し、内在的報酬とタスク目標を分離することで学習シグナルの歪みを防止する。さらに、長期的な依存関係を捉える後継距離ベースの内在的報酬を統合し、多様で時間的に拡張された探索を促進する。SMAX、VMAS、MPEなどのベンチマークにおいて、既存手法を上回る協調戦略の発見能力を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習手法とベンチマーク評価が関心に合致

papers.title: Scalable Bayesian Gaussian Process Classification for Cancer Histopathology: Calibrated Uncertainty Under Distribution Shift
papers.summary: Reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for clinical deployment of cancer diagnosis models, yet neural networks and variational Gaussian process methods can produce overconfident predictions, particularly under the distribution shifts that arise when models trained at one hospital are applied at another. We present a scalable Bayesian Gaussian Process Classification (GPC) framework that operates on frozen pathology foundation model embeddings (Phikon) and combines accelerated Randomly Pivoted Cholesky (RPCholesky) for low-rank kernel factorization, Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) with non-centered parameterization for posterior sampling, and a pivots-as-inducing-points scheme for prediction. This makes HMC posterior sampling in the low-rank latent representation tractable at N approximately 300,000 training points, enabling HC-based low-rank GPC on substantially larger datasets than prior MCMC-based demonstrations. We evaluate on two histopathology benchmarks for breast cancer metastasis detection: PCam and CAMELYON17-WILDS, where the latter tests calibration under hospital-level distribution shift. Compared to stochastic variational GP and neural network baselines, our method improves calibration and predictive performance - reducing expected calibration error by up to 88% and false negative rate by up to 90% - with the largest gains appearing under distribution shift, suggesting that HMC-based posterior sampling provides more trustworthy uncertainty estimates for cross-site pathology classification.
papers.title_ja: がん組織病理学のためのスケーラブルなベイズガウス過程分類：分布シフト下での較正された不確実性
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、がん診断モデルの臨床導入における信頼できる不確実性定量化を目的とし、凍結された病理学ファウンデーションモデル（Phikon）の埋め込みを用いたスケーラブルなベイズガウス過程分類（GPC）フレームワークを提案する。低ランクカーネル分解のための加速Randomly Pivoted Cholesky法と、非中心パラメータ化を用いたハミルトンモンテカルロ法（HMC）を組み合わせることで、約30万点の訓練データ規模でも後方分布サンプリングを可能にした。乳がん転移検出のベンチマーク（PCam, CAMELYON17-WILDS）において、特に病院間の分布シフト下で、期待較正誤差を最大88%、偽陰性率を最大90%低減し、既存の確率変分GPやニューラルネットワークベースラインを上回る較正性能と予測性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: ベイズ最適化・ガウス過程の手法と、大規模データでの効率化・評価手法が関心に合致

papers.title: Bayesian Tensor Train Kernel Machines with Automatic Model Complexity Inference
papers.summary: Tensor Network (TN) kernel machines accelerate supervised learning by using low-rank TNs to reduce computation and memory. However, most TN-based methods are deterministic with manually tuned ranks and feature dimensions, while the existing Bayesian TN kernel machine is restricted to the CANDECOMP/PARAFAC decomposition (CPD), whose single rank is shared by all modes. We extend this framework to the tensor train (TT) and propose Bayesian Tensor Train Kernel Machines (BTT-KM), whose hierarchical ARD-type priors on the TT cores infer the TT ranks and feature dimensions from data. Since each TT core is coupled to the others only through its neighbors, its closed-form posterior update requires propagating the contributions of all other cores along the chain. Mean-field variational inference yields a Bayesian alternating least squares algorithm with the same computational complexity as its deterministic counterpart and a closed-form predictive distribution. A synthetic experiment illustrates that BTT-KM recovers the true TT ranks and feature dimensions from an over-parameterized initialization.
papers.title_ja: 自動モデル複雑度推定を備えたベイズ・テンソル・トレイン・カーネル・マシン
papers.summary_ja: テンソルネットワーク（TN）カーネルマシンにおいて、既存のベイズ手法がCPD分解に限定されていた問題を解決するため、テンソルトレイン（TT）分解への拡張を提案する。TTコアに対する階層的ARD型事前分布を導入することで、TTランクと特徴量次元をデータから自動推定可能にする。平均場変分推論を用いることで、決定論的手法と同等の計算複雑度で後方分布を更新し、予測分布の閉形式解を得る。合成実験により、過剰パラメータ化された初期値から真のTTランクと特徴量次元を正しく復元できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: ベイズ最適化・機械学習手法全般への深い関連性

papers.title: Teaching Agents the "Principle", Not the "Reward"
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning has achieved strong performance in many tasks by letting agents learn from nothing more than a reward signal. However, in more complex tasks, agents still struggle to learn good, generalizable policies, even with carefully designed rewards and abundant samples. We argue that this difficulty stems from the reward decoding burden: designers encode their knowledge of the desired behavior into rewards and penalties, and agents must infer this knowledge from long sequences of noisy scalars. To address this burden, we propose prescriptive policy learning (PPL), which directly teaches agents higher-level knowledge about the tasks, termed principles of behavior, such as how to maintain balance, how to accumulate energy, and how to land smoothly. Through appropriately selected key quantities and references, PPL can directly indicate at every step whether the agent follows the principles and to what extent. Our experiments show that agents can learn good, generalizable policies without any reward. Taught only simple heuristic principles, PPL agents outperform reward-based methods with far fewer samples. Their policies also transfer directly to harder settings and keep performing well, demonstrating their strong generalization ability. In summary, PPL provides a new approach in which rough knowledge of the desired behavior is enough for agents to learn good, generalizable policies, even when the system dynamics cannot be accurately modeled.
papers.title_ja: 報酬ではなく「原理」をエージェントに教える
papers.summary_ja: 強化学習における報酬設計の負担を軽減するため、行動の原理（バランス維持やエネルギー蓄積など）を直接エージェントに教える「指示的ポリシー学習（PPL）」を提案する。この手法では、報酬シグナルなしで、より少ないサンプル数において報酬ベースの手法を上回る汎化性能を持つポリシーを学習できる。さらに、学習したポリシーはより困難な設定にも直接転移可能であり、システム動力学を正確にモデル化できない場合でも有効であることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習の効率化と汎化性能向上というユーザーの関心に強く関連する。

papers.title: Meta-Frieren: Beyond Single Level Online Learning
papers.summary: We study a two-stage online optimization problem: at each round, a meta-learner first selects an agent-environment pair, then the chosen agent interacts with the environment, and receives a reward. We introduce Meta-Frieren, a general framework for maximizing cumulative reward in this setting. Our analysis yields a simple UCB-style criterion for meta-level selection and recovers prior guarantees as special cases while extending them to broader settings. We instantiate Meta-Frieren with GP-UCB under Bayesian and frequentist assumptions. We also derive, to our knowledge, the first high-probability regret bound for Feel-Good Thompson Sampling, specialize it to finite and parametric function classes, and integrate it into Meta-Frieren. Experiments support our theoretical results and demonstrate that Meta-Frieren can be successfully applied to hyperparameter optimization across multiple model classes.
papers.title_ja: Meta-Frieren：単一レベルのオンライン学習を超えて
papers.summary_ja: メタラーナーがエージェントと環境のペアを選択し、報酬を得る2段階のオンライン最適化問題を対象とする。提案手法Meta-Frierenは、累積報酬の最大化を目的とした汎用的なフレームワークであり、メタレベル選択のためのUCB様基準を導出する。ガウス過程（GP）を用いたGP-UCBやFeel-Good Thompson Samplingとの統合により、ベイズ的・頻度論的仮定下での理論的保証を拡張した。実験では、複数モデルクラス間のハイパーパラメータ最適化への適用可能性を実証している。
papers.relevance_reason: ガウス過程とベイズ最適化の理論的拡張であり、ハイパーパラメータ最適化に直結する。

papers.title: Evaluating Language Model Features for Zero-Shot Time-Series Anomaly Detection Under Isolation Assumption
papers.summary: Time-Series Anomaly Detection (TSAD) is a fundamentally challenging task: it is unsupervised, requires high local precision capabilities, and suffers from limited labelled data. Recent work has explored adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to time-series via cross-modal transfer. However, existing approaches are poorly suited to Multivariate TSAD (MTSAD), as tokenisation often obscures fine-grained temporal and variables structures, and most methods optimise auxiliary objectives such as forecasting or reconstruction. We posit that these surrogate objectives become unreliable as model capacity increases. Highly expressive models risk reconstructing or forecasting anomalies, undermining the foundations of both strategies. Instead, we propose to use LLMs purely as feature extractors and directly analyse their induced feature spaces. In this work, investigate the ability of LLMs to provide useful representations for MTSADs in a zero-shot setting through classification. To this end, we study the separability of the extracted features, under the assumption that anomalous features should be isolated from normal ones. We analyse their temporal and contextual discriminative ability using simple step-wise tokenisation schemes, with one time-step per token, which preserve fine-grained local information. Their usability for MTSAD is assessed using an unsupervised Isolation Forest, enabling a direct evaluation of the resulting representation quality. We further investigate whether the observed performance can be attributed to the language-related pre-training of the LLMs or arises independently of it. Our results provide empirical insight into the ability of LLMs to represent multivariate time-series for anomaly detection and highlight broader applications of cross-modal foundation models.
papers.title_ja: 分離仮定に基づくゼロショット時系列異常検出における言語モデル特徴の評価
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、大規模言語モデル（LLM）を時系列異常検出（TSAD）の特徴抽出器として活用する手法を提案する。従来の予測や再構成といった代理目的がモデル能力の向上に伴い信頼性を失う問題を指摘し、LLMが生成する特徴空間の分離可能性に直接注目する。1トークン1タイムステップのトークナイズにより細粒度の時間的情報を保持し、Isolation Forestを用いてゼロショット環境下での異常検出性能を評価した。さらに、その性能が言語事前学習に依存するのか、それとも独立して生じるのかを分析し、LLMによる多変量時系列表現の限界と可能性を実証的に示している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM活用だが時系列異常検出特化で軌道力学やRAGとは距離がある

papers.title: Echoes of Error: Residual-Directional Local Rollout Consistency for Timeseries Forecasting
papers.summary: In time-series forecasting, rollout errors are not merely one-step fitting discrepancies: once fed back into the evolving state, they can perturb future predictions. We formalize this effect through local rollout consistency, which compares the next prediction produced under teacher forcing with that produced under free running. In principle, this consistency can be enforced directly by tracking the residual-induced perturbation of the next state. In practice, however, the residual-to-state alignment operator is often difficult to design when the input state and output block have different dimensions, heterogeneous components, or architecture-dependent layouts. We therefore use a first-order local surrogate that penalizes the Jacobian-vector product of the predictor along the actual feedback perturbation, suppressing precisely the directions through which self-generated errors remain visible to future predictions. We further give the same loss a geometric interpretation near a predictive manifold: by controlling residual-induced directions that probe the normal bundle, the objective yields theoretical conditions under which free-running trajectories remain inside a stability tube around the manifold. Experiments on time series forecasting tasks support this view, showing that the proposed regularization improves predictive accuracy. More broadly, our results suggest a training principle for time-series forecasters and sequential predictors: a model should not only make small one-step errors, but also learn not to let its own errors echo into the future. Code is available at https://github.com/Wangzzzzzzzz/Echoes-Of-Error.
papers.title_ja: 誤差のエコー：時系列予測における残差方向性ローカルロールアウト整合性
papers.summary_ja: 時系列予測において、自己生成された誤差がフィードバックされ未来予測を乱す「ロールアウト誤差」問題に対処する手法を提案する。教師強制と自由実行の予測差を最小化するローカル整合性損失を定義し、次元や構造が異なる状態空間でも適用可能な一階近似サロゲート（ヤコビアンベクトル積）を用いて実装する。予測マニホールド近傍での幾何学的解釈を通じて、自由実行軌道が安定チューブ内に留まる理論的条件を示し、実験により予測精度の向上を実証している。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルの概念は関連するが、対象が時系列予測であり軌道力学ではないため

papers.title: Understanding Data Influence in Transportation Networks: A Physics-Constrained Influence-Function Framework
papers.summary: Understanding how individual training observations influence model predictions is important for developing reliable and interpretable data-driven transportation systems. Existing influence-function methods, however, are primarily formulated for unconstrained learning and do not explicitly account for physical constraints that couple different components of a transportation network. Under such constraints, perturbing a training observation can affect model parameters and predictions only through physically feasible directions, potentially changing how its influence propagates across the network. This paper develops a hard physics-informed influence-function framework for constrained learning, in which training-data influence is characterized within the physically feasible space defined by network constraints. The analytical results reveal how physical constraints alter the magnitude, direction, and spatial distribution of training-sample influence relative to conventional influence measures. Using traffic prediction under flow-conservation constraints as a case study, we show that influential observations identified by the proposed framework differ systematically from those identified by classical influence functions. Through orthogonal decomposition, we quantitatively characterize how much of a perturbation in the training data is propagated through the network via the flow-conservation constraints and how much is removed by the constraint projection. The proposed influence framework provides a physically consistent approach for evaluating training-data influence in constrained transportation learning problems, with potential applications to data diagnostics, sensor evaluation, and targeted data collection.
papers.title_ja: 交通ネットワークにおけるデータ影響の理解：物理制約付きインフルエンス関数フレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、交通ネットワークの物理的制約（流量保存則など）を明示的に考慮したインフルエンス関数フレームワークを提案する。従来の無制約学習向け手法とは異なり、物理的に実現可能な空間内で訓練データが予測に与える影響を解析的に特徴づける。流量保存制約下での交通予測をケーススタディとし、物理制約がデータ影響の大きさ・方向・空間分布をどのように変化させるかを定量的に示した。この手法は、データ診断やセンサー評価、ターゲットデータ収集における物理的に整合性のある評価を可能にする。

papers.title: Same Behavior, Different Mechanism: What Finite Experiments Can Certify About Integrated Information
papers.summary: Interpretability, AI auditing and assessments of machine consciousness increasingly rest on mechanism-level quantities: functionals of a system's causal transition law that describe how it computes, not what it outputs. Experiments see that law only through finite, partial and noisy interventions. We ask when such a quantity is identifiable from an experiment's access, continuous in the mechanism and certifiable from finite data, and answer exactly for a deliberately demanding case - the integrated information $\varphi$ of integrated information theory - in stochastic networks of four and five units with known ground truth. Behavior can be silent: a recurrent and a feed-forward network with identical input-output laws at their response delay carry 0.28 and 0 bits, yet internal recordings separate them within 4-53 trials. Partial access can be just as blind: in our examples, units left out of a one-step recording impose precision floors of 0.30-1.02 bits that no sample size lowers, and in all-but-self parity networks, recordings of any length see several hidden units only through the product of their fidelities - a symmetry that one intervention broke in exact checks. The measure has sharp edges: because $\varphi$ selects a partition, and the cause and effect it specifies, by one criterion and reports another, infinitesimal changes of mechanism that cross an edge change it by 25-100% at 99% of the edges we found in random networks, and about 1% of surrogate models that fit interventional data almost perfectly misreport it by more than 20%. One-sided claims survive: the same data certify a lower bound on both sides of an edge, and we prove $\varphi>1.004$ bits throughout a 64-dimensional region of mechanisms and certify it from about $10^7$ controlled transitions with false-certificate probability at most $\alpha$. Measurability is thus a design question with computable answers.
papers.title_ja: 同じ挙動、異なるメカニズム：有限な実験が統合情報について証明できること
papers.summary_ja: 統合情報理論（IIT）における指標φが、有限かつ部分的な介入データから識別可能かつ証明可能である条件を、4〜5ユニットの確率ネットワークで厳密に解析した。入力出力挙動が同一でも内部構造の違いによりφ値が異なり、少数の試行で区別可能である一方、観測対象の選択次第では精度の下限が生じることが示された。また、φはメカニズムの微小変化に対して不連続（鋭い境界）を持ち、サロゲートモデルの約1%が介入データを高精度で適合させつつもφを大きく誤報告する可能性がある。しかし、境界の両側で下界を証明する手法は有効であり、有限データからの信頼性ある推定は設計問題として計算可能であることが証明された。

papers.title: Multimodal Information Interactions Bottleneck for Multimodal Self-Supervised Learning
papers.summary: Multimodal self-supervised learning is challenged by heterogeneity, unequal informativeness, and complex information interactions across multimodal data sources such as images, text, audio, and tabular data. While contrastive methods effectively align shared semantics, they typically rely on strong multi-view redundancy assumptions, overlooking modality-specific and synergistic information, thus leading to suboptimal representations. We propose the Multimodal Information Interactions Bottleneck (MIIB), a principled framework grounded in Partial Information Decomposition that explicitly encodes redundant, unique, and synergistic information within multimodal interactions. MIIB employs a dual-path model architecture for modality-specific encoding and multimodal fusion, optimized using surrogate tractable entropy-based objectives that enforce minimal sufficient representations without requiring explicit mutual information estimation. By leveraging variational bounds and score-based entropy estimation, MIIB efficiently captures complex cross-modal interactions while suppressing superfluous information. Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art multimodal self-supervised methods. Code is available at https://github.com/wanglingzaishi/MIIB.
papers.title_ja: マルチモーダル自己教師あり学習におけるマルチモーダル情報相互作用ボトルネック
papers.summary_ja: マルチモーダル自己教師あり学習において、既存の対比学習法がモダリティ固有の情報やシナジー効果を過小評価する問題を解決するため、部分情報分解（PID）に基づくMIIBフレームワークを提案する。この手法は、冗長・固有・シナジー情報を明示的にエンコードし、変分境界とスコアベースのエントロピー推定を用いて、相互情報量の直接推定なしに最小十分表現を効率的に学習する。多様なベンチマーク実験により、既存の最先端手法を上回る一貫した性能向上を実証している。

papers.title: tok: a textual concrete syntax of BPMN and DMN for humans and AI agents
papers.summary: tok is a plain-text notation for Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) 2.0.2 process models and Decision Model and Notation (DMN) 1.5 decisions. One engine checks a tok document against both standards, compiles the document to XML with an automatic diagram, and serves language-model applications through the Model Context Protocol. The paper classifies the notation as an alternative concrete syntax of the BPMN and DMN metamodels and reports one study. A tok model takes 2.2 times fewer tokens than the smallest BPMN XML of 893 files exported by 37 tools and 7.7 times fewer than the files as exported. The checker signals 98.2% of 1,411 injected faults, against 85.8% for the XML Schema with bpmnlint. Four language models new to tok write valid tok from a one-page reference for 85.7 to 100% of 87 process descriptions from two datasets and valid BPMN XML for every description, and the strongest model writes tok with 25% and 19% fewer tokens than BPMN XML. As agents with a lean skill and one checker tool, the models write valid tok for 97.6 to 100% of the descriptions, the strongest model spends 21% and 14% fewer tokens on tok than on BPMN XML, and a skill which sends the model to read the reference through a tool costs 1.7 to 2.8 times the tokens of the lean skill. Of 47 event logs simulated from public models, 44 fit their source models, and tok imports every model discovered from the logs.
papers.title_ja: tok: 人間とAIエージェントのためのBPMNとDMNのテキストベース具体構文
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、BPMNおよびDMNモデルをプレーンテキストで記述する構文「tok」を提案し、LLMとの連携を強化する。tokはXML形式と比較してトークン数を大幅に削減し、LLMによるモデル生成の効率と正確性を向上させる。さらに、Model Context Protocolを通じてエージェント設計を支援し、少ないリソースで高品質なプロセスモデルを生成できることを実証している。

papers.title: Output-Feedback Integral Sliding-Mode Extremum Seeking with Super-Twisting Differentiation
papers.summary: This paper develops a dither-free output-feedback extremum-seeking controller for pre-stabilized nonlinear dynamic systems with unknown steady-state performance maps. The controller uses only the measured performance, the applied parameter, and internal states. Within a local state--parameter domain, integral sliding mode enforces equality between the applied parameter rate and a prescribed nonzero search velocity after finite-time capture under bounded matched rate-channel perturbations. This motion lets a super-twisting differentiator and rate normalization recover a gradient-sign surrogate without demodulation or averaging. A ramp-corrected moving-equilibrium coordinate cancels the first-order ramp-induced plant term and yields explicit flow, reversal, recovery, and dynamic-remainder bounds. The resulting local state--parameter tube supplies the regularity needed for finite-time exact differentiation. Combined with a deadbanded hybrid relay, these results establish local practical convergence to an explicit neighborhood of the unknown optimum. An 80-state tubular-reactor benchmark and paired held-out Monte Carlo tests compare a causal sampled realization with perturbation ESC and a rate-informed super-twisting comparator. The proposed realization succeeds in all 200 held-out cases and attains the smallest upper-tail objective gap under the stated tuning protocol. A matched-rate sweep connects performance degradation to applied-rate mismatch, near-stall motion, reversal, and regularization attenuation.
papers.title_ja: スーパーツイスティング微分を用いた出力フィードバック積分スライディングモード極値探索
papers.summary_ja: 既知の定常性能マップを持たない非線形動的システム向けに、ジッターフリーな出力フィードバック型極値探索（ESC）制御器を提案する。積分スライディングモードにより有限時間で所定の探索速度を強制し、スーパーツイスティング微分器を用いてデモジュレーションや平均化なしで勾配符号のサロゲートを復元する手法である。80状態の管状反応器ベンチマークにおいて、200件の保持アウトテストで全て成功し、既存手法より小さい目標ギャップを達成した。

papers.title: Depth or Description? When a One-Step Latent Score Replaces Lookahead in Proactive Information Acquisition
papers.summary: A proactive agent must decide what to ask before it acts. Exact lookahead values combinations of questions but is expensive and leans on a fitted model; a one-step score is cheap but can miss them. Our main finding: the need for depth often lies in how the hidden cause is described. A one-step score on the label can be blind to an interaction among answers. A score on a suitable latent cause is not, and where that latent encodes the decision it replaces most of depth at a fraction of the search. Described differently, the same problem can defeat the score while exact values do not move, so keep the latent small and check it against exact values. Probabilities learned from one language model's answers do not carry to another unless planning allows for both; those read from tokens are worth only a few labels.
papers.title_ja: 深さか記述か？能動的な情報収集においてルックアヘッドを置き換える1ステップ潜在スコア
papers.summary_ja: 能動的エージェントが行動前に質問内容を決定する際、正確なルックアヘッドは計算コストが高く、安価な1ステップスコアは相互作用を見逃す可能性がある。本研究では、隠れた原因（潜在変数）の記述方法が重要であり、適切な潜在変数に対するスコアが深さのある探索を大幅に削減しつつ同等の性能を発揮することを示した。また、異なる言語モデル間の確率移転は計画処理なしでは困難であり、トークンから読み取った確率は限定的な価値しか持たないことを指摘している。

papers.title: A Survey of Nonlinear Filtering Methods for Data Assimilation and Recent Advances in Generative AI-Enabled Score Filters
papers.summary: Many real-world applications, such as numerical weather prediction or wildfire tracking, involve modeling highly nonlinear dynamical systems that are chaotic and influenced by various sources of uncertainty. To improve model prediction accuracy and reduce such uncertainties, data assimilation (DA) combines the dynamical model with partial, noisy observations to estimate the evolution of the system's state. Doing so depends on solving the optimal filtering problem: computing the conditional distribution of a hidden state given a sequence of observations. Classical approaches fail along three distinct axes: Kalman-based methods assume Gaussian posteriors and produce biased estimates under nonlinear observation operators; particle-based methods represent distributions with weighted samples and collapse in high dimensions due to the curse of dimensionality; and kernel-based methods move beyond discrete particle representations but cannot maintain their density approximation affordably as dimension grows. The Ensemble Score Filter (EnSF) avoids all three constraints by encoding the filtering density in a score function and approximating that score with a training-free Monte Carlo estimator, enabling stable filtering in high-dimensional, chaotic systems. This survey traces EnSF's mathematical foundations, establishes it as the state of the art for non-Gaussian, high-dimensional filtering, and examines fourteen extensions that expand its operational reach. Twelve of the fourteen extensions preserve this training-free Monte Carlo estimator at the core of the update, with only two departing from it to achieve planetary-scale deployment.
papers.title_ja: データ同化における非線形フィルタリング手法のサーベイと、生成AIを活用したスコアフィルタの最近の進展
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、数値予報や野火追跡など高次元・カオティックな非線形システムにおけるデータ同化手法を総説する。従来のカルマンフィルタ、パーティクルフィルタ、カーネルベース手法の限界を指摘し、スコア関数を用いてフィルタリング密度を表現するアンサンブルスコアフィルタ（EnSF）を最新のSOTAとして位置づける。EnSFは学習不要のモンテカルロ推定器により高次元でも安定した推定を可能にし、その数学的基礎と14種の拡張手法を詳述する。特に、2つの例外を除く12の拡張が学習不要な推定器を核としており、惑星規模の展開に向けた技術的進展を整理している。

papers.title: Compositional Unalignment: Auditing Safety in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are vulnerable to compositional harm: an image and a prompt that are benign in isolation become harmful through the model's cross-modal reasoning. Recent alignment methods report strong scores on compositional safety benchmarks, but an LLM judge only measures observed behavior and cannot reveal how robustly safety is integrated into the model. We argue that un-alignment provides a complementary audit of alignment robustness. We first show that minimal supervised fine-tuning reaches an LLM-judge score comparable to a multi-stage reinforcement-learning pipeline, so similar benchmark scores cannot establish robustness by themselves. We then show that recognition and refusal of compositional harm are decoupled: nine standard direction-finding methods detect compositional harm with up to AUC=0.99, yet ablating the recovered directions either leaves refusal intact or destroys model coherence. We therefore propose CMaG, a training-free un-alignment method for compositional safety. CMaG measures refusal intention with a refusal-versus-compliance log-probability margin, takes its gradient with respect to mid-layer activations, and contrasts it against partially benign pairs to isolate the cross-modal interaction term. A single backward pass over 80 examples yields a direction along which steering monotonically converts refusal into compliance. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B and LLaVA-1.5-7B, CMaG reduces compositional safety scores by up to 65 points while over 98% of outputs remain coherent, outperforming gradient-based baselines; the direction also transfers to text-explicit harm and un-aligns models hardened by defensive training. Compositional safety can thus appear behaviorally strong while remaining fragile to targeted internal intervention. Warning: this paper contains unsafe model outputs, including references to self-harm.
papers.title_ja: 構成的アンアライメント：大規模ビジョン言語モデルにおける安全性監査
papers.summary_ja: 大規模ビジョン言語モデル（LVLM）の安全性が、単一の入力は無害でも組み合わせによって有害になる「構成的ハーム」に対して脆弱であることを示す。既存のベンチマークスコアは強固な安全性を保証しないことを実証し、拒否と認識が解離していることを指摘する。提案手法CMaGは、中間層活性化に対する勾配を用いて安全性を無効化する方向性を特定し、少数のサンプルでモデルの安全性を大幅に低下させることを可能にする。これにより、行動ベースの評価では検出できない内部の脆弱性を監査する手法を提供する。

papers.title: How do Transformers Perform Low-Level Control In-Context?
papers.summary: One of the remarkable abilities of Transformer-based neural networks is in-context learning. This motivates us to think about "in-context" control. Can we control a system knowing only (1) that it belongs to a particular family of systems and (2) some data on system evolution (provided as the context trajectory) but no specific parameter information? Specifically, we investigate the ability of Transformer-models to perform "in-context" control of unstable, nonlinear dynamical systems, where context consists only of the unforced system dynamics. We leverage a multi-head, GPT-2-style architecture, and we evaluate performance for two classical nonlinear systems -- the cartpole system and the two-link acrobot system, where the system parameters are unknown to the Transformer. We consider a setting where trajectories from an expert controller are available at training time but not at inference time. Here, we identify training techniques that are essential to train Transformers to perform low-level control. Through an analysis over checkpoints, we show that in-context control is possible, and the learned policy performance generally improves as context increases. Furthermore, the Transformer models can generalize to stabilize systems that are out-of-distribution.
papers.title_ja: Transformerはコンテキスト内で低レベル制御をどのように行うのか？
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、パラメータ情報なしでコンテキスト軌道のみから不安定な非線形動的系を制御するTransformerの能力を調査する。GPT-2様アーキテクチャを用い、カートポールやアクロバットシステムにおいて、推論時に専門家制御器の軌道が利用できない設定で性能を評価した。チェックポイント分析により、コンテキストの増加に伴い制御性能が向上し、分布外システムへの一般化も可能であることを示す。

papers.title: Uncertainty calibration in Bayesian M/EEG source imaging
papers.summary: M/EEG source imaging requires accurate localization and reliable uncertainty estimates, yet posterior credible regions are rarely assessed for empirical calibration. We present a simulation-based framework for uncertainty quantification and calibration of empirical Bayesian inverse methods with closed-form conditional Gaussian posterior summaries. We compare Bayesian minimum norm (BMN) with sLORETA depth weighting and sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) with sparse basis field expansions (S-FLEX). S-FLEX allows retained coefficients to contribute nonzero marginal posterior variance at locations where voxel-wise SBL yields degenerate variances. For BMN, we derive joint source- and noise-variance updates through evidence maximization. We test whether adaptive noise learning yields near-calibrated uncertainties. Both methods retain residual miscalibration, motivating post-hoc isotonic recalibration of credible-region levels using empirical coverage. Simulations assess fixed- and free-orientation models across signal-to-noise ratios (SNR), source sparsity levels, and subject-specific head models, using oracle, baseline-estimated, and adaptively learned noise. Before recalibration, SBL+S-FLEX yields lower Wasserstein localization error, smaller posterior uncertainty, and coverage closer to nominal credibility than BMN+sLORETA. Isotonic recalibration improves both methods, with larger gains for conservative BMN+sLORETA posteriors; transfer across mismatched SNR, sparsity, and head models remains condition dependent. Noise specifications yield broadly consistent reconstruction and uncertainty trends within each estimator. In real auditory MEG data, SBL+S-FLEX provides more focal localization and tighter uncertainties than BMN+sLORETA, suggesting greater statistical power for identifying bilateral auditory sources.
papers.title_ja: ベイズ M/EEG ソースイメージングにおける不確実性の較正
papers.summary_ja: M/EEG のベイズ逆問題手法における後验分布の不確実性較正を評価するシミュレーションフレームワークを提案する。ベイズ最小ノルム法とスパースベイズ学習を比較し、後者のほうが局在化誤差が低く、信頼域のカバレッジが名目値に近いことを示した。両手法とも残存する較正ずれに対し、経験的カバレッジを用いたアイソトニック再較正が有効であることを確認した。実測 MEG データでも、スパースベイズ学習がより焦点的な局在化と緊密な不確実性を提供し、双側聴覚ソースの同定に優位であることが示された。

papers.title: Big Models, Small Gains: Frozen Forecasters as Classifiers on MONSTER
papers.summary: Forecasting foundation models are increasingly used as frozen feature extractors for time series classification, but it remains unclear whether their pretrained representations offer an advantage over strong classifiers that do not require pretraining. This raises an important question: do these representations provide useful information beyond what the model architecture alone can capture, particularly when labelled data are scarce? We present a controlled benchmarking of two forecasting models, Reverso and Chronos-Bolt, on six large datasets from the MONSTER benchmark, using 1%, 10%, and 100% of the available training labels. We compare their frozen representations against four established time series classification methods and random-weight versions of the same forecasting models. Our results show that pretraining improves classification accuracy over random-weight counterparts on five of the six datasets, with gains of up to 23 percentage points. However, the frozen representations do not reliably outperform the strongest non-pretrained baseline in any setting: they perform worse in 15 of 17 settings and tie in the remaining two. Further experiments show that restoring amplitude information recovers part of the performance gap, while fine-tuning and forecast-error features do not close it. These findings highlight the importance of strong task specific baselines and random weight controls when evaluating forecasting foundation models for classification. Our code is available at https://github.com/Rachet2006/frozen-forecasters-monster.
papers.title_ja: 大きなモデル、小さな利得：MONSTERにおける凍結フォアキャスターとしての分類器
papers.summary_ja: 時系列分類において、事前学習済みの予測基盤モデル（Reverso, Chronos-Bolt）の凍結表現が、事前学習を要しない強力な分類器やランダム重み版モデルに対して優位性を示すかを検証した。結果、事前学習はランダム重み版より精度を向上させるものの、最も強力な非事前学習ベースラインには17設定中15設定で劣り、信頼できる優位性は確認されなかった。振幅情報の復元が性能差の一部を縮小する一方、ファインチューニングや予測誤差特徴量は差を埋められなかった。この研究は、予測基盤モデルの評価において強力なタスク特化ベースラインとランダム重みコントロールの重要性を強調している。

papers.title: ToroFit: Fitting Wedge Sums of Tori to High-Dimensional Data
papers.summary: Data arising in scientific applications often exhibits complex nonlinear structure. Identifying and parameterizing said nonlinearities can enable better modeling, enhance predictive analysis, data interpolation, denoising, and anomaly detection. In this paper, we develop theoretical and computational methods to detect and parametrize Euclidean point cloud data lying near a wedge sum of tori. Specifically, we use persistent cohomology and cup products to identify the distinct toroidal components, and on each component, we optimize over low-energy multivariate trigonometric polynomials for best data fit. The ensuing optimization problem reduces to generalized ridge regression, which can be solved efficiently via standard techniques. We demonstrate the utility of the proposed framework in both synthetic and real datasets, including interpolation of low frame-rate recurrent videos, attractor recovery in quasiperiodic dynamical systems, and the parametrization of gene-space cycle data for parasites and humans.
papers.title_ja: ToroFit: 高次元データへのトーラスのウェッジ和のフィッティング
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、高次元データ中の複雑な非線形構造、特にトーラスのウェッジ和に近い点群を検出・パラメータ化するための理論的・計算的手法を提案する。持続コホモロジーとカップ積を用いてトーラス成分を識別し、各成分に対して低エネルギーの多変数三角多項式による最適化を行う。この最適化問題は汎用リッジ回帰に帰着し、標準的な手法で効率的に解ける。合成データおよび実データ（低フレームレート動画の補間、準周期的力学系のアトラクター復元、寄生虫やヒトの遺伝子空間サイクルデータのパラメータ化）における有効性を示す。

papers.title: Shaping & Monitoring Models through their Internal Representations
papers.summary: We propose Mechanistic Shaping, a unified framework for shaping models through their internal representations. Mechanistic Shaping is applied during training so that models follow specifications (rules) about which concepts they express, measured via their outputs or internal representations (e.g., no harmful content), and also which concepts they rely on, i.e., what they use to make their decisions (e.g., not a candidate's gender when screening a r\'esum\'e). Across multiple domains (vision, medical imaging, language), scales (up to 32B parameters), and training paradigms (classification, SFT, DPO, GRPO), we find that Mechanistic Shaping substantially reduces targeted behaviors while preserving task performance. Since training against a representation can also modify it, we ask whether shaped concepts remain monitorable, a question that depends on the class of monitors considered. We therefore introduce a hierarchy of such classes, which separates a concept that escapes one probe from a concept that is truly gone. We characterize three geometric mechanisms of circumvention: the concept can drift away from the monitor, be erased from the layer, or persist in higher-order statistics as a nonlinear encoding, which we explain through a product-code construction. Although other mechanisms may arise in different settings or at larger scales, these three account for all of our observations, and each can be detected by a matching monitor. In practice, we find that shaped concepts largely remain monitorable: refitted linear probes recover the concept in most settings, and the original probe remains reliable whenever gradients do not flow through it. Taken together, these results point to the potential of using interpretability as a tool for training, and call for a correspondingly rigorous science of interpretability-based training.
papers.title_ja: 内部表現を通じたモデルの整形と監視
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、モデルの内部表現を操作して特定の概念（有害コンテンツや偏りなど）を制御する「Mechanistic Shaping」という統一フレームワークを提案する。視覚・医療画像・言語の複数ドメインで、タスク性能を維持しつつ対象行動を大幅に削減できることを示した。さらに、整形後も概念が監視可能かという問題に対し、監視器の階層構造と3つの幾何学的回避メカニズムを定式化し、多くのケースで線形プローブによる再監視が可能であることを検証した。解釈可能性を訓練ツールとして活用する新たなアプローチを提示している。

papers.title: Optimistic Hedge in General-Sum Games: Fundamental Limits and Regret Bounds via Temporal Approximation
papers.summary: Optimistic Hedge, a multiplicative weight update with one step of extrapolation, is one of the most natural regret-minimizing dynamics for games, and characterizing its regret has been a longstanding open question. Daskalakis, Fishelson and Golowich proved that if all $m$ players in a finite general-sum game follow Optimistic Hedge with a fixed learning rate, each player's regret is polylogarithmic in the horizon $T$. Subsequently, Ha showed that an appropriate choice of learning rate makes each player's regret bounded independently of $T$. This bound, however, is non-constructive and its dependence on the number of actions $n$ is not explicit, leaving open whether Optimistic Hedge can achieve a constant regret bound which is polynomial in the size of the game. We show that the answer hinges on the number of players. In two-player games, there is a learning rate for which Optimistic Hedge guarantees $O(n\log n)$ regret independent of the horizon. In three-player games, however, no such bound is possible: for any learning rate up to an absolute constant and for sufficiently large horizon $T$, there is a game with $n$ actions per player in which some player's regret is $2^{\Omega(n)}$, and more generally, for every $m\ge3$ we construct $m$-player games in which some player's regret is $2^{\Omega(mn)}$; for learning rates above $2^{-\Omega(mn)}$, that player's regret even grows linearly in $T$. Our upper bound is based on a temporal approximation framework for the analysis of Optimistic Hedge. Starting from the variance-based RVU bound of Daskalakis et al., we approximate the losses over time-localized windows by well-behaved functions, whose total variation is a small fraction of their cumulative variance. In $m$-player games, the same framework gives a significantly simplified proof of the recent $O(\sqrt{m}\log n\log T)$ regret bound due to Ha.
papers.title_ja: 一般和ゲームにおける楽観的ヘッジ：時間近似による根本的な限界とリグレット境界
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、ゲーム理論における学習アルゴリズム「楽観的ヘッジ」のリグレット（後悔）境界を解析する。2人ゲームではホライズンに依存しない $O(n\log n)$ のリグレット保証を示す一方、3人以上のゲームでは指数関数的に悪化する反例を構成し、プレイヤー数による根本的な限界を明らかにした。解析には、損失関数を時間局所的な窓で近似する「時間近似フレームワーク」を用い、既存の複雑な証明を簡略化しつつ、学習率とゲームサイズへの依存性を明示的に導出した。

papers.title: Synthesizing symbolic models of human and machine reasoning at scale
papers.summary: Symbolic models offer a powerful account of cognition, but their scope has historically been limited by the need for hand-engineering and computational tractability. We show how advances in artificial intelligence (AI) can scale symbolic modeling and help overcome these engineering limitations. We introduce Behavior-Conditioned Symbolic Synthesis (BCSS)---an approach for automated search of interpretable, deterministic symbolic programs that verifiably reproduce behavior---and apply it to model both human and machine behavior across hundreds of challenging reasoning problems. Analyzing these programs reveals that both people and machines tend to oversimplify, adopt rules that are partial explanations for their observations, and misinfer dependencies between problem features. These shared signatures are modulated by available resources, with reasoning effort predicting the extent to which machines simplify and explain their observations. Together, these results point to underlying mechanisms reminiscent of satisficing in both people and machines, and illustrate how BCSS offers a general approach for interpreting and comparing rule-based reasoning of humans and black-box AI systems.
papers.title_ja: 人間と機械の推論の象徴的モデルの大規模合成
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、AIの進歩を活用して象徴的モデリングの限界を克服する手法「BCSS（行動条件付き象徴的合成）」を提案する。BCSSは、解釈可能かつ決定論的な象徴的プログラムを自動探索し、人間と機械の行動を再現する。数百の推論問題への適用により、両者とも過剰に単純化し、部分的な説明規則を採用する傾向があることが明らかになった。これらの結果は、人間とブラックボックスAIシステムのルールベース推論を比較・解釈するための一般的な枠組みを提供する。

papers.title: Regulating Autonomous Mobility-on-Demand Operators with Fixed and Adaptive Penalties: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Approach
papers.summary: Profit-maximizing Autonomous Mobility-on-Demand (AMoD) operators may exploit consumer surplus through excessive prices and underserve less profitable regions by relocating vehicles away from them. We study how penalty-based regulation of an AMoD operator in a multimodal mobility system can limit surge pricing and improve regional service availability. We model regulation as an outer control loop that acts on a learning-based operator. Static regulation with fixed penalties is formulated as a Markov Decision Process for an operator that jointly controls pricing and rebalancing, and dynamic regulation as a Partially Observable Stochastic Game in which a regulator periodically adjusts region-specific penalties in closed loop. Operator and regulator policies are learned with graph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning. In experiments with real-world Manhattan data, fixed surge pricing penalties reduce the share of travelers facing excessive prices from 22% to 1%. For regional service availability, dynamic regulation improves the regulator's reward by up to 15.6% over fixed penalties of equal mean intensity. The gains in service availability are strongest when spare fleet capacity exists, whereas service deficits persist in peak periods with highly utilized fleets. The learned regulator policy responds by reducing penalties where limited fleet capacity restricts compliance. The results identify trade-offs between regulatory targets, operator profitability, and traveler utility.
papers.title_ja: 固定型および適応型ペナルティによる自律型オンデマンド交通事業者の規制：マルチエージェント強化学習アプローチ
papers.summary_ja: 自律型オンデマンド交通（AMoD）事業者の利益最大化行動が消費者に与える影響を緩和するため、ペナルティベースの規制手法を提案する。事業者の価格設定と車両再配置を制御する内側ループに対し、規制当局がペナルティを調整する外側ループを設計し、両者をグラフベースのマルチエージェント強化学習で学習させる。マンハッタン実データを用いた実験では、固定ペナルティで高価格に直面する旅行者の割合を22%から1%に削減し、適応型規制では地域サービス可用性を最大15.6%向上させた。ただし、ピーク時の車両不足下ではサービス欠如が依然として残るというトレードオフも明らかになった。

papers.title: Data-Driven Modeling of Molten Chloride Corrosion Using Static Test Data
papers.summary: Molten chloride corrosion has been studied for decades, yet reliable prediction across different alloys, salts, and test conditions remains difficult. In this work, 291 static molten chloride corrosion experiments reported in the literature were compiled into a structured dataset and used to develop an interpretable machine-learning framework for corrosion-rate predictions. To better represent the differences in salt condition across studies, a Chloride Salt Preparation Index (CSPI) was introduced to bring the reported salt-treatment method, atmosphere control, and pre-exposure impurity condition on a common numerical scale. A blended tree-based ensemble provided the most consistent predictive performance, achieving a cross-validated \(R^2\) of 0.85 and an MAE of 0.41 mg cm\(^{-2}\) day\(^{-1}\). The graded CSPI retained more useful information than a simple purified/unpurified classification and emerged as the dominant model descriptor. Global sensitivity and SHAP analyses further identified exposure time, temperature, and alloy chemistry as important contributors to the model predictions, with several observed trends consistent with the established molten-chloride corrosion behavior. The conformal prediction intervals were well calibrated, providing an estimate of prediction uncertainty in addition to the point prediction. Overall, the framework demonstrates that historical corrosion data can support quantitative, interpretable, and uncertainty-aware prediction when experimental context is represented explicitly, while also highlighting where more consistent reporting and targeted experiments are needed to improve future molten-salt corrosion models.
papers.title_ja: 静的試験データを用いた溶融塩化物腐食のデータ駆動型モデリング
papers.summary_ja: 文献から収集した291件の溶融塩化物腐食実験データを用い、解釈可能な機械学習フレームワークを構築した。塩の調製条件を数値化する指標（CSPI）を導入し、ツリーベースアンサンブルモデルにより腐食速度を予測した。交差検証でR^2 0.85、MAE 0.41 mg cm^-2 day^-1の性能を示し、SHAP解析や適合予測区間により予測の不確実性も評価した。

papers.title: Structural Conditional Independence Test via Neural Quantile Resolution
papers.summary: Conditional independence testing is difficult when dependence is weak, localized, or expressed through distributional changes rather than a global mean shift. Existing tests usually return a scalar statistic or p-value, which summarizes evidence against independence but does not describe where the conditional law changes. We propose QRCIT, a quantile-resolution conditional independence test that compares P(X|Z) and P(X|Y,Z) through a quantile deformation learned by a shared model. A lightweight residual quantile-flow model first learns the baseline conditional quantile law and then learns the additional deformation induced by Y, yielding a global predictive-gain statistic with conditional-randomization calibration and an inspectable deformation field over context and quantile level. We also introduce the Structural Dependency Benchmark (SDB), which evaluates dependence structures motivated by real applications, such as context-local, tail-only, sign-reversing, moving-ridge, and mean-neutral patterns. Across synthetic post-nonlinear (PNL) and SDB benchmarks, QRCIT improves detection of structured alternatives, with empirical Type-I behavior evaluated across settings. Higher quantile resolution improves merged-SDB power at moderate sample sizes, while diagnostics restricted to known affected regions improve detection of localized dependence. On Sachs, METABRIC breast cancer, and CCLE/PLX4720, QRCIT provides competitive real-data performance and interpretable deformation patterns. These results support quantile-resolved conditional-law deformation as a practical framework for testing and diagnosing structured conditional dependence.
papers.title_ja: ニューラル量子分解による構造的条件独立性検定
papers.summary_ja: 弱い依存性や局所的な分布変化を検出する条件独立性検定手法 QRCIT を提案する。共有モデルによる量子変形を通じて条件分布の変化を可視化し、スカラー統計量だけでなく依存構造の診断も可能にする。実データ応用を含むベンチマークで、既存手法より優れた検出力と解釈性を示した。

papers.title: Structured Machine Theory of Mind from Agent Trajectories
papers.summary: Predictive models of human behavior trained on large-scale trajectory data optimize for statistical accuracy without representing the mental states that causally generate behavior. Such models support prediction but not principled intervention: they cannot answer how an agent's behavior would change if its beliefs or preferences were different. We introduce Structured Machine Theory of Mind (SMToM), a framework that attributes explicit, independently supervised belief and desire representations from observed trajectories within a Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) causal structure. The central architectural element is a goal head that consumes only the predicted mental-state channels and a current-trajectory embedding; counterfactual intervention on beliefs and desires is a direct operation. We instantiate SMToM on a controlled pedestrian navigation domain where ground-truth mental states are known by construction, enabling evaluation of attribution accuracy, local channel interventions, and trajectory-level counterfactual diagnostics. The resulting model, BDIBottleneck, improves over trajectory-only and unsupervised-context neural baselines. It is also competitive with a matched auxiliary-supervised context baseline while providing an editable mental-state interface that the unbottlenecked baseline lacks. Counterfactual experiments on desires confirm that substituting an agent's inferred preferences with a different activity type coherently shifts predicted destinations toward relevant locations. Counterfactual experiments on beliefs confirm that marking a location as unavailable in the agent's belief state reduces its predicted probability as a destination, though in a complex way. These results demonstrate, in a controlled navigation setting, that explicit BDI-structured supervision is a viable foundation for interpretable and counterfactual analysis of longitudinal trajectory data.
papers.title_ja: エージェントの軌道から構築される構造化された機械的理論的マインド
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、観測された行動軌道から信念・欲望・意図（BDI）の因果構造を明示的に推論するフレームワーク「SMToM」を提案する。従来の統計的予測モデルとは異なり、信念や欲望への反事実的介入が可能であり、エージェントの行動変化を原理的に分析できる。歩行者ナビゲーション領域での実験により、このモデルはベースラインを上回る精度と、編集可能なメンタル状態インターフェースを提供することを示した。

papers.title: Task-Calibrated Random Features via Influence-Based Error Cancellation
papers.summary: Random features approximate kernel integrals by Monte Carlo, yet only selected frequency-sampling errors affect a downstream task. We propose Task-Calibrated Random Features (TCRF), which balance frequency moments constructed from task-specific influence using weights shared across kernel entries. Closed-form weights coincide with classical minimum-distance calibration; the contribution is a reusable, task-derived calibration space. We show that first-order variance equals the residual variance after projection onto this space. For kernel ridge regression, complete cancellation yields a non-Gaussian second-order limit. For kernel Stein discrepancy, a subset identity and disjoint-block variance decomposition eliminate the linear component of pilot noise. Positive exponential-tilting weights preserve the positive-semidefinite feature representation and support higher feasible calibration ranks. Paired experiments show improved approximation to exact kernel ridge regression at larger frequency budgets and to the exact empirical Stein discrepancy under a fixed alternative, even after accounting for a frequency-equivalent pilot budget. Gains are smaller with cross-validated ridge, landmark pilots require conservative rank selection, and near the Stein null allocating the pilot budget to additional ordinary frequencies is preferable.
papers.title_ja: 影響度ベースのエラーキャンセルによるタスク較正ランダム特徴量
papers.summary_ja: カーネル積分のモンテカルロ近似において、下流タスクに実際に影響を与える周波数サンプリング誤差のみを特定し、タスク固有の影響度を用いて周波数モーメントをバランスさせる手法「TCRF」を提案する。この手法は、古典的な最小距離較正と一致する閉形式の重みを導出するとともに、再利用可能なタスク由来の較正空間を提供する。カーネルリッジ回帰やカーネルシュタイン乖離において、線形成分のノイズを除去し、より少ない計算コストで正確な近似を実現する。実験により、従来のランダム特徴量法と比較して、特に大きな周波数予算下での近似精度の向上が示されている。

papers.title: Canonical Correlation Neural Networks
papers.summary: Relational inductive biases such as grids or graphs allow neural networks with fewer trainable parameters and improved generalization, but require a known structure beforehand. When no structure is available, the covariance matrix provides a principled substitute, and coVariance Neural Networks (VNNs) have shown that using it yields models that are theoretically grounded in Principal Component Analysis, stable to finite-sample estimation errors and parameter-efficient. This framework, however, is limited to single-view data, whereas many applications observe the same phenomenon through multiple views, each with its own in-view covariance and a cross-view covariance linking them. To incorporate these matrices as inductive biases in a principled way, we introduce CAnonical correlation NEural networks (CANEs), architectures that use in-view and cross-view covariances as distinct relational biases to solve downstream tasks. Via spectral analysis, CANEs draw analogies with Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA), a classical technique to project two-view data onto a correlated subspace. However, while CCA's objective is to compute shared view representations, CANEs are trained to solve a downstream task directly. We bound their output error under finite-sample covariance perturbations and show that it depends on controllable Lipschitz constants of the learned filters in place of the singular-value gap that governs the stability of CCA, thus guaranteeing better robustness. Experiments on seven datasets from brain imaging and motion sensing show that CANEs match or outperform single-view, two-view and CCA-based baselines, often with fewer parameters, and retain their performance when covariances are re-estimated from fewer samples.
papers.title_ja: 正則相関ニューラルネットワーク
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、複数視点のデータにおける共分散行列を誘導バイアスとして活用する新しいアーキテクチャ「CANEs」を提案する。従来の単一視点モデルの限界を克服し、正則相関分析（CCA）の理論的枠組みを拡張することで、下流タスクへの直接適用を可能にする。有限サンプルにおける共分散の摂動に対する出力誤差の上限を導出し、CCAよりも高い頑健性を理論的に保証している。脳画像やモーションセンシングなどの7つのデータセットでの実験により、パラメータ効率と汎化性能の両面で既存手法を上回ることを示した。

papers.title: Machine Learning for Live-Birth Prediction After IVF/ICSI From Structured Clinical Data: A Systematic Review, Meta-Analysis, and Critical Appraisal
papers.summary: Machine-learning models predicting live birth after in vitro fertilisation (IVF) or intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) from routine clinical data report performance from near chance to near perfect. We systematically reviewed these models under PRISMA 2020, searching OpenAlex, Scopus and Web of Science to 22 October 2026, appraised them with PROBAST+AI and TRIPOD+AI, and pooled their discrimination with random-effects meta-analysis on the logit scale. We define what fixes the meaning of a model's output (decision point, endpoint, unit of analysis, data source) and map the 48 included studies by model family, decision point and validation design. Models evaluated only internally pooled to an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.814, against 0.756 (95% prediction interval 0.546-0.889) for models evaluated on a later period or another centre, and 0.764 for studies not at high risk of bias; neither difference was significant, and heterogeneity was extreme. Models whose decision point was not stated pooled to 0.910, the only significant moderator in meta-regression. Against logistic regression fitted to the same data, the best machine-learning model gained a pooled 0.056 AUC (95% CI 0.017-0.090). Of 48 studies, 47 were at high or unclear risk of bias, only four assessed the calibration slope, and no model has evidence of clinical impact. The certainty of the pooled evidence is low to very low; the gains that survive validation came from staging predictions to decision points and local calibration, not deeper architectures. We provide a TRIPOD+AI-mapped checklist, a benchmark specification and a research agenda.
papers.title_ja: 構造化臨床データを用いたIVF/ICSI後の出生予測における機械学習：体系的レビュー、メタ分析、および批判的評価
papers.summary_ja: IVF/ICSI後の出生を予測する機械学習モデルの48研究を体系的にレビューし、メタ分析を行った。内部検証のみを行ったモデルのAUCは0.814であったが、外部検証やバイアスリスクが低い研究では0.75〜0.76程度に低下し、モデルの汎化性能には限界があることが示された。ロジスティック回帰と比較した際の機械学習の優位性は限定的であり、多くの研究がバイアスリスクが高く、臨床的インパクトの証拠は欠如している。本論文は、モデル出力の意味を固定する定義や、TRIPOD+AI準拠のチェックリスト、ベンチマーク仕様、今後の研究アジェンダを提供する。

papers.title: Robust Stream Classification using Time Neutralising Decision Trees
papers.summary: Data Streams are characterised as a potentially infinite source of data subject to non-stationarity. This non-stationarity, also called Concept Drift, often results in deployed predictive models having to be perpetually retrained as the underlying data generating process of the stream changes over time. Drift Detectors are a class of methods used to identify these changes, triggering these retraining procedures. Historically, Stream Learning has operated under the assumption that instances are only seen once, and cannot be stored for later use. Contemporary work relaxes this assumption, yet drift detection and simple resetting procedures are still ubiquitous. Building on related work which has shown that traditional Batch Learning algorithms often outperform Stream Learning algorithms when instances can be stored, we introduce Time Neutralising Trees (TNT), a Decision Tree architecture that enables robust stream classification in settings with Concept Drift. During training, TNT will filter out ("neutralise") old training samples that are no longer relevant given the current context of the stream. If those instances become relevant again, TNT will then re-include them. We evaluate TNT, and related algorithms on 24 real and semi-real classification data streams from the USP DS repository. Results show strong evidence that TNT achieves best-in-class performance on a wide-range of data streams with varying concept drift types.
papers.title_ja: 時間中立化決定木を用いた頑健なストリーム分類
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、概念ドリフト（非定常性）が存在するデータストリーム分類において、従来のストリーム学習手法の限界を克服する決定木アーキテクチャ「Time Neutralising Trees (TNT)」を提案する。TNTは、現在のストリームコンテキストに対して関連性が低い古い訓練サンプルをフィルタリング（中立化）し、再び関連性が高まった際にそれらを再包含する仕組みを持つ。USP DSリポジトリの24個の実データストリームを用いた評価により、多様な概念ドリフトタイプに対してTNTがクラス内で最高水準の性能を発揮することが示された。

papers.title: Backbone-Informed Adaptation after EEG Pretraining: A Capacity-Controlled Study
papers.summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models learn representations that combine information across channels and time. This structure motivates adapters that model the same relationships during downstream learning. However, it is not clear whether such a design outperforms other candidate adapters. Moreover, in order to arrive at a fair comparison between candidate adapters, we also need to consider their trainable parameters. Here, we ask whether a backbone-informed (native) adapter makes better use of a given capacity by comparing it against a token-wise multilayer perceptron control that transforms each feature vector independently. We approximately match their trainable parameter counts and keep the pretrained encoder fixed. Across two EEG foundation models and tasks covering emotion recognition, sleep staging, and EEG event classification, the native adapter shows no consistent advantage. For one backbone, differences between the designs are small relative to variation across runs. For the other, the token-wise control performs better on emotion recognition and EEG event classification. On sleep staging, the native adapter's advantage over the token-wise control is reduced when we also train the component that processes sequences of EEG segments. The relative performance of the two adapters depends on the backbone, task, and downstream training protocol. These findings motivate evaluating backbone-informed adapters against capacity-matched alternatives.

papers.title: A minimal dynamical model of human-AI cognitive coevolution
papers.summary: The rapid deployment of generative AI raises the question of whether pervasive cognitive offloading drives a measurable, potentially irreversible decline in unassisted human reasoning. We examine this question with a phenomenological dynamical model based on the Cattell-Horn-Carroll distinction between fluid intelligence ($G_f$) and crystallized intelligence ($G_c$). Starting from the discrete-time Bivariate Latent Change Score formalism used in cognitive-aging research, we derive its continuous-time linear counterpart and introduce a fast third variable representing composite machine-intelligence capability. The machine variable enters the human subsystem through Hill-function modifications of the self-feedback and cross-coupling coefficients. We emphasize that our phenomenological model captures both the positive and negative effects of AI on human cognition. By formalizing the qualitative concepts of positive and negative impacts, we introduce definitions for AI-induced cognitive decline and AI-induced cognitive augmentation. A singular-perturbation reduction, justified via Tikhonov's theorem, collapses the resulting three-dimensional system onto a two-dimensional slow manifold. On this manifold we locate two bifurcations of the equilibrium. In one parameter regime, weakening the contribution of fluid reasoning to crystallized knowledge produces a saddle-node bifurcation that eliminates the stable positive equilibrium. In another, reversing the contribution of crystallized knowledge to fluid reasoning creates opposing feedback; increasing fluid self-feedback then reduces damping and produces a supercritical Hopf bifurcation with a stable periodic orbit. We discuss limitations and future directions, interpret our results as a phenomenological account of a coupled socio-technical system, and state the conditions under which each dynamical regime applies.

papers.title: Goal Revelation as a Bridge Between Information-Theoretic Empowerment and Capability-Based Human Power
papers.summary: Power matters for AI safety. Optimal agents tend to acquire power across a wide range of objectives (instrumental convergence). As we embed AI agents into socio-technical systems, humans risk gradual disempowerment. Both concerns call for a formal, quantitative measure of power. Two such measures in the context of Markov games are information-theoretic empowerment, the capacity of the channel from an agent's actions to future states, and capability-based individual power, a measure of goal attainment built from the probabilities that a human would attain each goal in a family of candidates were they pursuing it. We show where the two meet. From individual power, Fano's inequality yields a floor $B(s)$. This floor is a lower bound on what we term goal revelation, the mutual information $\mathbb{I}(G;\xi \mid s)$ between the human's latent goal and the realised trajectory. Empowerment caps revelation from above, so that $B(s) \le \mathbb{I}(G;\xi \mid s) \le \mathbb{I}(\mathbf{A}_h \to \xi \mid s) \le \mathfrak{E}_h(s)$. Each quantity can be large while the one below it stays at zero, highlighting the following failure modes. An assistant maximising empowerment can prefer an interface offering broad influence over goal-irrelevant degrees of freedom to one that lets the human attain every goal they might hold. An assistant maximising revelation cannot tell a working interface from one rewired so that every goal yields the wrong outcome, since relabelling goals leaves mutual information unchanged while zeroing every attainment probability. Positive guarantees therefore come only from the attainment end of the chain. A satisfaction floor, computable from two statistics of interaction logs, offers a way to monitor the power users retain in a deployed system, and simulations in random environments show the three quantities are correlated but far from interchangeable.

papers.title: Results from a Stellar Occultation by (623) Chimaera
papers.summary: We present results from a stellar occultation by the asteroid (623) Chimaera on October 21st, 2025, when it passed in front of V magnitude 13.86 star UCAC4 626-004193. Chimaera is the largest asteroid in the Chimaerid asteroid family and will be subject to a spacecraft flyby in the 2030s. Eighteen telescopes were deployed, spanning the United States from Arizona to North Carolina, incrementally spaced by $\sim4.4$\,km with respect to the cross-track of the shadow. In total, sixteen telescopes collected useful data. This multi-chord observation, when compiled into a single sky-plane plot, suggests a profile which is well-described by an elongated elliptical fit, with a semi-major axis $a=26.2\pm0.8$ km and a semi-minor axis $b=16.0\pm1.0$ km. The projected area from ellipse fitting is 1316 km$^2$, and a limb fit is calculated to enclose 1312 km$^2$. Photometry collected in the Gaia G band over a seven-month period coinciding with the occultation corresponds to a geometric albedo $p_G=0.059\pm0.005$; comparing with archival occultation observations and direct observations gives $p_G=0.051\pm0.004$ and $p_V=0.051\pm0.004$. We compare occultation sky-plane projections with 3-D modeling from inversion techniques and demonstrate that the models can accurately predict the orientation of Chimaera at the time of each occultation.

papers.title: Measures of maximal entropy for monotone factors of smooth surface diffeomorphisms
papers.summary: We prove that a transitive monotone factor of a smooth surface diffeomorphism has a unique measure of maximal entropy whenever its topological entropy is positive. Its entropy is the entropy of a single homoclinic class of the diffeomorphism, and the factor map is a measure-theoretic isomorphism on every ergodic measure with positive entropy of that class. The other homoclinic classes are mapped to periodic orbits. We give an application to the essential factor of a diffeomorphism isotopic to a pseudo-Anosov map ---possibly relative to a finite invariant set--- constructed by Garc\'ia-Sassi \& Tal: the essential factor has a unique measure of maximal entropy, which is Bernoulli and has full support.
